articleTitle: Optimization and Application of Algorithms in Educational Management Information Systems: Improving Data Processing Efficiency and Decision Support
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The growth in the volume and complexity of data within educational institutions detail the need for robust methods and systems for effective data collection and processing in making informed decisions. This research paper, therefore, seeks to examine and explore the application and optimization of advanced algorithms in Educational Management Information Systems (EMIS). As established, the paper focuses on strengthening decision-making support systems and enhancing data processing and efficiency. A comprehensive examination of existing algorithms and their inclusion in the educational sector will play a fundamental role in identifying improvement elements and establishing the need for innovative optimization models and techniques. This study, therefore, demonstrates how the optimization of algorithms may be used to reduce data processing periods, thus enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of predictive models that provide actionable insights to different stakeholders. Therefore, this study's findings underscore a transformative measure that may be used in optimizing EMIS, thus paving the way for data-driven and real-time educational management systems.

articleTitle: Research on University Sports Information Management System Based on Big Data and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper proposes a sports information management system based on Hadoop platform, which integrates convolutional neural network (CNN) technology to achieve efficient data management and intelligent decision support. Through this architecture system can effectively process and analyze the massive data from university sports activities, so as to improve the efficiency and accuracy of data processing. Secondly, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) technology is introduced to realize face recognition function. The application of this technology not only enhances the security of the system, but also improves the speed and accuracy of athlete identity verification. The automatic feature extraction capability of CNN enables the system to quickly identify key information in complex image data, which provides a strong technical support for the intelligence of sports management. In addition, the system provides rich data API interfaces, which can seamlessly connect various sports resources in colleges and universities, and realize data sharing and exchange. By building a unified sports big data environment, the system promotes the optimal allocation and efficient use of resources, and provides comprehensive data support for sports teaching, training and competition. This system builds a powerful sports information management platform by integrating Hadoop platform and CNN technology. This not only improves the ability of data processing and storage, but also greatly promotes the modernization process of college sports management through intelligent decision support.

articleTitle: Contextual Analysis Using Deep Learning for Sensitive Information Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This project intends to study A semantic feature extraction algorithm that combines semantic feature-oriented lexical vector representation with attention mechanism (A-ELMO). Firstly, the fast comparison of the dictionary tree reduces the comparison of invalid features as much as possible and greatly improves the speed of retrieval. A language pattern lexical vector (ELMo) model for context analysis is established. The method uses a dynamic word vector to describe the context, which improves the extensibility of the system. The attention mechanism is introduced to enhance the recognition degree of the sensitive features in the image. We improved detection rate of sensitive data. Compared to the traditional word-level emotion parsing algorithm, the proposed algorithm shows significant improvements in accuracy. Additionally, the accuracy of this algorithm surpasses that of traditional keyword comparison algorithms. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has clear advantages in enhancing the sensitivity and detection ability of the sensor.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation of Lagrange Mathematical Model Based on Deep Learning in High-Speed Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel algorithm model is proposed, which combines the efficient data processing capability of deep learning with the precise optimization characteristics of Lagrange mathematical model, in order to provide more accurate performance prediction in the complex and changeable network environment. The research begins with the construction of a deep learning framework, which is able to extract key features from a large amount of network communication data and learn and predict them through neural network models. Then the Lagrange mathematical model is integrated into the deep learning framework to form a comprehensive performance evaluation model. This model can evaluate the performance of communication network comprehensively while considering the multi-dimensional factors such as bandwidth, delay and packet loss rate. In order to verify the validity of the model, the corresponding system simulation platform is developed, and extensive simulation experiments are carried out in various high-speed communication network scenarios. The simulation results show that compared with traditional evaluation methods, the Lagrangian mathematical model based on deep learning has a significant improvement in prediction accuracy and response speed.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Methods for the Effectiveness of Adjustable Loads in Power Demand-Side Response Based on Load Interaction Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Demand response, as a new tool for optimizing power resources in the electricity system, provides key support for achieving efficient operation of the new electricity system and responding to the rapid development challenges of new energy. Emerging adjustable loads have become important participants in demand response, but the assessment methods for their participation are not yet perfect. This paper aims to propose a new assessment method to quantitatively evaluate the efficiency and quality of demand response by emerging adjustable load users. The paper first defines the calculation methods for a set of key performance indicators, including baseline load calculation, response load (electricity) completion rate, response time efficiency, annual response completion efficiency, and response comprehensive assessment level. The proposed evaluation method is validated through a typical case study, and practical mechanistic model references are provided for decision-making on demand response in the new electricity system.

articleTitle: Complex System Pattern Recognition Algorithm Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article explores the intricate and complex system pattern recognition algorithm based on backpropagation (BP) neural networks, which are efforts to leverage leverage's capabilities. Complicated systems, as seen in this case, are widely characterized by complex, nonlinear, and dynamic interactions and systems that pose challenges to traditional models and patterns of recognition. To this effect, a BP Neural Network that involves an artificial neural network plays a critical role in learning accuracy and efficiency that is integrated in addressing these intricate deficiencies. BP Neural Networks encompass an extensive and comprehensive dataset that helps discern correlations and underlying patterns in a complex system. The iterative adjustment of weights through the minimization of errors helps in accurately classifying and predicting patterns in complex systems. A typical approach involves training the BP Neural Networks through an extensive dataset, which allows underpinning to underpin the correlations and patterns in a complex system. The experimental results of this article revealed that the BP Neural network algorithms efficiently identified complex patterns, thus providing valuable insights into the model's efficiency in bioinformatics, finance, and engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm Based Music Creation and Automatic Composition System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Over the recent years, a notable increase and advancement in interest in regards to the use of algorithms in music creation and automatic composition has overly increased. This is attributed to the lack of authenticity and coherence in the generation of music. This study therefore seeks to conduct an examination and research on algorithms-based music creation and automation composition system. The primary goal of the research lies in the production of coherent and expressive musical pieces. In achieving the goals of the research, an experiment will be conducted to underscore the impact of different algorithms that include the Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and Deep Learning Approaches in music creation and automated composition. Trained data sampled from this research revealed that algorithms play a fundamental role in music creation and composition, demonstrating their capacity to help in the production of complex and harmonic musical arrangements. The findings of the research therefore add to the growth and the advancement of automated music creation and composition.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Collision Avoidance Trajectory Planning Based on Steering Geometry Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for cooperative drone avoidance trajectory planning based on the steering geometry model. Drones often encounter complex scenarios during flight, increasing the risk of collision with obstacles and subsequent damage. This study, demonstrates the existence of a unique shortest path among any number of flight paths between drone stations. Building upon the shortest path, considering the flight rates of drones A and B, along with the constraint of non-intersection, the priority of drone B reaching the target station is established. As drone A departs from the station, it rotates with a radius of 30 m for 12 cycles, ensuring that the two drones do not collide. Subsequently, by establishing the geometric relationship between the tangent of two steering circles and the tangent line of the shortest path, an optimized steering model for drone B to depart towards the shortest path is developed. This enables multiple adjustments of the flight trajectory of drone B towards the shortest path. The resulting length of the flight path for drone B is 4728.983 m, with a minimum time of 472.8983 s.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent System of English Communication Aid Software Based on Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore an innovative English communication aid software intelligent system that utilizes advanced speech recognition technology to improve the accuracy and efficiency of non-native speakers in English communication. The research focuses on the integration of feature parameter extraction methods, speech recognition models and human-computer interaction systems, as well as their application in practical communication scenarios. First, this study proposes an efficient feature parameter extraction method, which extracts key sound features such as Mayer frequency cepstrum coefficient (MFCCs) and linear predictive coding (LPCs) through in-depth analysis of speech signals, which are critical for subsequent speech recognition. By optimizing the extraction process of these parameters, the system can maintain good recognition performance under different background noise. Second, the study employs an advanced speech recognition model that combines deep learning techniques, especially convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs), to achieve accurate parsing of complex speech patterns. The model is trained with a large amount of spoken English data, and can effectively recognize English pronunciation with a variety of accents and speech speeds. In terms of human-computer interaction system, this research designs an intuitive and user-friendly interface that allows users to easily interact with the system. Through real-time feedback and automatic error correction, the system can assist users to correct pronunciation errors in real time, thereby improving the quality of communication. The experimental results show that the proposed system achieves the expected target in terms of recognition accuracy and response speed, and provides a powerful auxiliary tool for English learners and international communicators.

articleTitle: Source-load Prediction and its Adaptation Modeling based on Computer AI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic is becoming more and more favored by enterprises, but its installed capacity has plagued companies. This paper first studies the influencing factors of power load in enterprises. An enterprise electricity load forecasting model based on the Hidden Markov (HMM) model was developed. Then, the Gaussian-CNN-GRU model is used to establish the photovoltaic power generation prediction method. Finally, based on the results of load and PV power generation prediction, a complementary matching index between distributed PV and load is constructed, which improves the power generation efficiency and energy utilization of PV systems, reduces the dependence on traditional energy sources, lowers greenhouse gas emissions and environmental pollution, and helps to realize the efficient use of green energy and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Semantic Role Labeling Based on Graph Convolutional Networks in Discourse Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application of graph convolutional networks in semantic role labeling tasks in order to improve the depth and breadth of discourse understanding. Traditional semantic role labeling methods tend to focus on the capture of sequence information, but ignore the complex dependency between words. In order to solve this problem, the graph convolutional network is introduced into the semantic role labeling task for the first time in this study, and the long-distance dependency between words is effectively captured by constructing sentence-level graph structures. GCN model can integrate local and global semantic information at the same time, to identify and label semantic roles more accurately. In order to verify the validity and generalization ability of the proposed model, detailed simulation experiments are carried out on several public benchmark datasets. The experimental results show that compared with the existing semantic role annotation methods based on sequence annotation or tree structure, the proposed GCN model has achieved significant improvement in F1 value. This achievement not only fully proves the great potential of graph convolutional networks in semantic role labeling tasks, but also provides a new perspective and method for the study of discourse understanding.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing Strategy of Fresh Vegetable Commodities in Grocery Stores Based on Linear Regression and ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study explores the pricing strategy for fresh vegetable commodities in grocery stores using linear regression and ARIMA models. After preprocessing the data and excluding return transactions, Spearman correlation analysis revealed a significant negative correlation between total vegetable sales volume and cost-plus pricing. Further linear regression analysis confirmed this negative linear relationship, demonstrating the model's statistical significance. Subsequently, the ARIMA model was employed to analyze time series data, forecast future replenishment volumes, and pricing strategies to maximize supermarket profits. The ARIMA model captures trends and seasonality in the data through autocorrelation analysis, providing more accurate predictions for vegetable product pricing and replenishment. In the experimental section, stationarity of the time series was ensured through first-order differencing and ADF testing, and ARIMA model parameters were determined using ACF and PACF plots. Finally, the optimized model was used to forecast the replenishment volume and pricing strategy for July 1-7, 2023. The study concludes that the ARIMA model is an effective tool for supermarket managers to make data-driven decisions.

articleTitle: Seismic Receiver Functions Auto-picking Method Based on Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Seismic receiver function is a power tool to study the underground S-wave velocity structure and the layer interface structure in seismological research. Nevertheless, valid information extraction from massive observation data requires extensive manpower and tedious data processing. Therefore, it's significant to develop an Artificial Intelligence (AI) based method to achieve the goal of small labor costs in picking of receiver functions. A new seismic receiver functions auto-picking workflow is thus presented in this work using Pearson correlation coefficient and graph convolutional networks (GCN). A first step in constructing the topological graph by means of Pearson correlation coefficient to realize preliminary selection, and then GCN method is introduced to further selection. Experimental result from MDJ station shows that model with high accuracy and recall rate can be trained on a small amount of labeled data. This method facilitates to filter out redundant invalid data and provides high-quality receiver functions for subsequent seismic analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Practice Platform System of Japanese Syntax Teaching with Computer Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focuses on building a computer-aided Japanese syntax teaching practice platform system, aiming to improve Japanese learners' syntactic comprehension and application ability through advanced technical means. One of the core functions of the system is the sentence similarity calculation module, which uses natural language processing algorithm based on deep learning to accurately identify and compare the similarity between sentences input by learners and correct syntactic structures, so as to provide immediate feedback and personalized guidance for learners. In the process of system development, a series of simulation experiments are designed to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and the practicability of the system. The experimental results show that compared with traditional Japanese syntax teaching methods, this system can significantly improve learners' syntactic mastery speed and accuracy. In addition, the system can dynamically adjust the teaching content and difficulty according to the performance of learners to achieve personalized teaching. The Japanese syntax teaching practice platform system developed by this research institute provides a powerful computer-aided tool for Japanese language teaching, which is expected to bring about changes in the field of Japanese language education and promote the dual improvement of learning efficiency and teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Library Reader Behavior Analysis and Personalized Service
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the application of artificial intelligence in library reader behavior analysis and personalized service. In order to deeply understand reader behavior and provide personalized service, this paper designs a service automation awareness model, which uses the nearest neighbor search K-means clustering algorithm. Firstly, this paper collects the data of library readers' borrowing records, browsing history, and searching behavior, and preprocesses and extracts the features of these data. Then, we input these features into the service automation perception model, and use the nearest neighbor search K-means clustering algorithm to classify and predict reader behavior. In order to verify the validity and performance of the model, a system simulation platform was constructed to simulate the changes of readers' behavior data under different scenarios, and the performance of the model under different data distributions was observed. Simulation results show that the model can accurately identify readers' reading preferences and provide personalized book recommendation service.

Author Keywords: nearest neighbor search k-means clustering algorithm

articleTitle: Enhancing Reliability Assessment of Industrial Robot Systems Through the Integration of Wavelet Packet Transform and Hidden Markov Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Addressing the challenges in reliability analysis of industrial robot systems, this study proposes a novel fault diagnosis method based on wavelet packet transform and hidden Markov models. Initially, the method employs wavelet packet transform for feature extraction from the robot's motion data. Subsequently, the extracted features are input into a trained hidden Markov model to calculate the real-time likelihood probability corresponding to the current robot motion data. The robot system's current state is then determined based on the relationship between the real-time likelihood probability and state thresholds, facilitating fault diagnosis. For scenarios involving multiple robot systems, a fault prediction method combining Weibull distribution and hidden Markov models is introduced. This method estimates the robot's reliability Weibull distribution model based on its fault-free operation time. Features are extracted from the robot's motion data using wavelet packet transform and input into a trained state assessment model for performance evaluation. Lastly, an expectation-maximization algorithm within the hidden Markov model, combined with Weibull distribution, trains the fault prediction model. Simulation validates the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Visualization Scene System for Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper conducts an in-depth study on the development of visualization scene system for power grid enterprises, aiming to achieve efficient management and intuitive display of power grid resources through the combination of Internet of Things and three-dimensional visualization technology. The study first focuses on the optimization of the geographical location of substations. The method of combining force-directed algorithm with greedy algorithm is adopted to effectively adjust the display ratio and spacing of substations, making the entire power grid layout more reasonable and easier to understand. Then, in order to solve the problem of power line wiring, the Delaunay algorithm and its repeated version are introduced. By intelligently segmenting the lines, mutual interference and overlap between lines are avoided, and the accuracy and aesthetics of line planning are significantly improved. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by computer simulation, which proves the great potential of the system in improving the level of visualization management of power grids. This study not only provides new ideas and technical support for the development of visualization scene system for power grid enterprises, but also provides a useful reference for research and practice in related fields.

articleTitle: A Computer Network Training Data Center Resource Monitoring Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article presents the development of a visual monitoring platform for educational resources, encompassing both hardware components and software applications, specifically designed for the training setting of computer network technology programs in light of the swift advancements in next-generation information technologies. The platform is based on a B/S architecture. It facilitates, supports, and handles operational tasks through three core platforms, including a real-time data platform, an alarm platform, and a monitoring platform. These systems ensure the transparent capture and storage of educational resource data, which subsequently gets uploaded to a cloud management platform to establish a visual operational mechanism. It monitors computer rooms, hardware, and application resources, providing security alarms and maintenance event logs. The system offers real-time data updates and integrates 2D and 3D visualization technologies to display resource information clearly, aiding administrators in managing cloud platform infrastructures.

articleTitle: Research on the Stability of Pattern Recognition Collaborative Algorithms Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The contemporary era and world of big data has seen the stability of advanced pattern recognition and collaborative algorithms that are critical in the practical process ofdata mining. This research study primarily delves into the factors that significantly enhance algorithms' stability and optimized function. This factor is focused on ensuring reliable and consistent recognition models and patterns. Based on this context, this research primarily focuses on including data mining techniques to bolster collaborative algorithms' optimized functions and robustness. Through a comprehensive analysis of a myriad of data sets, factors that significantly influence the stability of these algorithms are underscored. Findings, therefore, indicate that incorporating pattern recognition and collaborative algorithms based on data mining significantly improves the algorithmic stability of a system. Thus, the research findings validate the extensive and empirical simulation and tests that efficiently maintain stability in a pattern recognition model.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Coordination and Optimization Design Based on Source Network Load Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article conducts research on energy optimization configuration of the “source network load storage” system in regional energy networks. The system has constructed a regional cogeneration power supply network architecture, including an energy network composed of the power grid and gas grid, and has built an electricity gas joint energy supply system, achieving electricity gas interaction coupling. This article constructs equations for photovoltaic and wind power supply, thermal energy, and energy storage, and establishes objective functions based on economic indicators. This article establishes a dynamic economic dispatch model for regional energy networks, with the goal of minimizing operating costs, analyzing the energy interconnection coordination model, and achieving optimization of multi energy coupling in regional energy networks.

articleTitle: Underwater AUV Path Planning Algorithm Based on GWHASSA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the application of an Adaptive Sparrow Search Algorithm Based on Mixed Gray Wolf Hierarchy (GWHASSA) in underwater AUV path planning. Given the complex marine environment, this paper lists some problems of traditional path planning methods, then, the sparrow search algorithm as a new intelligent optimization technology is introduced. It has the advantages of simple parameters and fast search speed. Path planning problem for solving underwater robots, the article proposes an underwater AUV path planning method based on a hybrid grey wolf hierarchical structure adaptive sparrow search algorithm (GWHASSA). This method takes into account complex marine environments and influencing factors such as ocean currents, and the velocity synthesis method and the fitness function of integrating ocean currents were introduced to evaluate the state of particles and perform path planning. At the same time, strategies such as dynamic inertia weights and adaptive proportional changes were introduced to improve global search capability and optimize position updates. The article used simulation software for a computer simulation environment, and performance tests were conducted on different testing functions. The results indicate that this method has a shorter path length compared to other classical and heuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of Power System Operation for Renewable Energy and Advanced Energy Storage Technology Based on Comprehensive Data of New Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach to simulating and optimizing power system operations with a focus on large-scale integration of renewable energy sources, such as wind and photovoltaic power, alongside advanced energy storage technologies. Amid stringent global carbon emission restrictions and dwindling mineral resources, accurately modeling renewable energy outputs is critical for assessing peak load regulation and absorption capacities. The study explores current trends and future directions in energy storage within the Jiangsu power grid, projecting an installed capacity of 5 million kilowatts by 2027. It highlights various storage technologies, including electrochemical, compressed air, gravity, flywheel, superconducting, supercapacitor, and hydrogen storage. Emphasis is placed on new energy storage integrated real-time data and digital twin technologies for real-time monitoring, fault detection, and optimization, enhancing storage system efficiency and safety. The proposed simulation model optimizes coordination between conventional and renewable energy sources, validated through empirical research on the Jiangsu power grid. The findings underscore the necessity of robust models to manage the variability and uncertainty of renewable energy, paving the way for future research in multi-objective optimization and adaptive modeling for improved grid management strategies. This study plays a vital role in the planning and assessment of large-scale renewable energy deployment and utilization.

articleTitle: Warehouse Cargo Visual Positioning and Storage Efficiency Improvement Analysis Based on Adaptive Generalized S-Transform Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, an innovative method based on adaptive generalized S-transform algorithm is proposed to improve the accuracy of visual positioning of warehouse goods and optimize the overall storage efficiency. The algorithm can be dynamically adjusted to adapt to different storage environments and workloads, effectively reducing the time required for system adjustment. This research focuses on automating the operation of the stacker in the three-dimensional warehouse to achieve two key objectives in the process of cargo access: one is to ensure that the center of gravity of the shelf in the three-dimensional warehouse is at the lowest state to enhance the stability of the structure; The second is to pursue the maximum reduction of total pick-up time, so as to improve operational efficiency. The proposed method shows remarkable advantages in practical application, not only improves the accuracy of goods positioning, but also greatly improves the handling capacity and response speed of the storage system. In addition, the algorithm has good scalability and flexibility, and can adapt to the more complex and changeable needs of warehouse management in the future. The adaptive generalized S-transform algorithm proposed in this study provides an effective technical path for the intelligent upgrading of modern logistics and warehousing.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Generation Algorithm of AIGC in Digital Media Content Creation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore how AIGC (Generative Artificial Intelligence) drives innovation in digital media content creation and proposes a new content generation framework based on Generative Multiple Adversarial steganography (GMASS). By integrating advanced machine learning models, the framework enables efficient generation and editing of image, video and audio content, while ensuring content security and privacy. Firstly, this paper summarizes the basic principle of AIGC and its application in the field of digital media, and points out its potential in improving creative efficiency and reducing production cost. Then, aiming at the challenges of the existing content generation technology in privacy disclosure and copyright infringement, the GMASS algorithm is proposed. The algorithm makes use of the characteristics of adversarial network to generate content and embed an imperceptible information hiding layer to effectively prevent unauthorized copying and tampering. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework, detailed system modeling and simulation experiments are carried out in this paper. The experimental results show that the GMASS algorithm can significantly improve the content security while maintaining the quality of the generated content. In addition, by comparing with traditional steganography techniques, GMASS's superior performance in resisting various attack methods and media content generation frameworks is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Urban Emergency Response Optimization Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Effective and rapid emergence approaches and responses remain critical in minimizing the impacts of accidents and disasters in the modern urban environment. This article, therefore, draws attention to optimization algorithms that are effectively used in urban emergency response. These efforts will play a fundamental role in leveraging their capabilities through deep learning. These algorithms are primarily designed to analyze a significant amount of urban emergency data from historical incident data, traffic patterns, and population densities-to predict and optimize emergency response approaches. This article examines the integration of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in the temporal and spatial data analysis process. The experimental results reveal improvements in resource allocation and response times in rapid emergencies compared to the traditional models. The examined model not only plays a critical role in enhancing the accuracy and speed of emergency response but also adapts to the significantly changing conditions within urban settings, providing an effective and robust solution to emergency management in emerging smart cities.

articleTitle: Research on Human Resource Intelligent Recommendation Method Based on Improved Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The information age's continuous growth and expansion have seen several potential workers seeking information about job openings online. This has resulted in the escalation of human resource data and information on relevant talent information, contributing significantly to the growth of information overload. Besides this, improved learning algorithms have made significant strides and developments in different fields, spanning human resource management, education, and the medical field. To address the issue of information overload within the human resource management sector, this paper seeks to propose a design model for a human resource recommendation algorithm that functions on improved learning algorithms. The comprehensive consideration of the improved learning algorithm is informed by the need to consider a broader scope of behaviours and characteristics of the job features and individuals seeking to fill these positions. As established in this case, implementing the improved learning algorithms considers the assembly of varied learning models merged in designing a human resource intelligent recommendation system. Findings revealed a significant improvement in human resource management recommendation systems upon including improved learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration and Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Interdisciplinary Experimental Teaching of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore how virtual reality technology can be combined with interdisciplinary experimental teaching in higher education, and realizes the deep integration of teaching content and the improvement of interactive experience by constructing an experimental environment with integrated computer platform. Firstly, this paper analyzes the application status of virtual reality technology in the field of education, and points out its unique advantages in simulating complex experiment scenes and providing immersive learning experience. Then, the paper deeply discusses the application of sparse coding algorithm model in VR experiment teaching, which can effectively process a large number of visual data, improve the efficiency and quality of image processing, and thus enhancing the learning effect of students. The study explores the application of system simulation technology in virtual reality experimental teaching, which allows students to conduct complex experimental operations in a safe virtual environment while providing the possibility of immediate feedback and personalized learning paths. This simulation technology not only reduces the cost of the experiment, but also improves the repeatability and flexibility of the experiment.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Inspection System for Coal Mine Equipment Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Equipment inspection is an important foundation and prerequisite for ensuring the safe and stable operation of equipment. Due to the complexity and danger of the underground environment, its characteristics can easily pose a huge threat to the safe operation of equipment. At the same time, based on the current situation of various types and complex structures of coal mine production equipment, this article combines the actual situation of coal mine production and proposes a detailed design of an intelligent inspection system based on the Internet of Things. A coal mine equipment intelligent inspection system is proposed, which is built on the basis of the Internet of Things, handheld terminals, clients, and servers, to improve the efficiency of coal mine equipment inspection and reduce the failure rate.

articleTitle: Research on Submarine Localization Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of submarines and the increasing concern about the safety of this program, this study constructs a localization model and a search model for search and rescue after an accident. In addition, we provide a series of equipment recommendations and fundamentals to minimize the risk of accidents. We deeply analyze the influencing factors and obtain the key factors (ocean currents, seawater density, and seafloor topography), and then we process the obtained data related to the key factors, such as clustering, rasterization, and visualization. Using the processed data, we propose a three-dimensional physical model to analyze the impact on the submersible. Based on this physical model, we constructed a multilayer cross-location model (MLCL) to predict the positional trajectory of the submersible over time. To verify the accuracy of the model predictions, we propose a probability distribution model to comparatively validate the MLCL model. The final results show that the accuracy of the MLCL model is above 91%.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Metro Service Based on LSTM Model and Floyd Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the feasibility and effectiveness of optimizing subway services by adding express trains, taking the Beijing subway system as an example. First, we comprehensively collected parametric indicators such as average daily passenger flow, full load rate, and breakdown frequency, and utilized LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) Model to predict passenger flow at subway stations. This method can effectively capture the time dependency and provide accurate passenger flow prediction. Under the scientific premise of the correlation analysis method, we identified the congestion factor and the failure factor as key judging indicators. Through the empowered comprehensive evaluation method, we meticulously analyzed the degree of demand and necessity of opening long-distance direct routes at each location, followed by selecting the seven existing metro lines with the highest demand indexes, which narrowed down the scope for subsequent site selection. After that, we deeply analyzed the average peak hour fullness rate of each station in the shortlisted lines to identify the stations with the highest demand in each line. Then, we applied the graph theory idea to rank all the alternative stations and calculated the shortest paths between them with the help of the Floyd model. Based on the principle of minimizing the operation cost, the unique optimal route was finally determined. Finally, the economic and social benefits of each route were fully evaluated. The study shows that the addition of express trains can effectively alleviate the congestion problem of the metro system, reduce the frequency of failures, and improve the overall service quality, thus providing an important theoretical basis and practical guidance for the sustainable development of urban rail transit systems.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Load Forecasting Based on Improved Extreme Learning Machine of Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Electric load forecasting is pivotal in the planning and operation of power systems, as accurate predictions can significantly enhance operational efficiency and stability. In recent years, with the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence technology, various intelligent algorithms have emerged as focal points in load forecasting research. The Extreme Learning Machine (ELM), a novel neural network algorithm, has garnered considerable attention due to its fast training speed and strong generalization capabilities. However, traditional ELM approaches have inherent limitations when dealing with complex nonlinear problems. This study proposes an enhanced ELM model based on artificial intelligence algorithms, integrating the artificial firefly algorithm and artificial fish swarm algorithm. These innovations optimize the initial parameters and network structure of ELM, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of load forecasting. Experimental analysis using real-world electric load data validates the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model. The research findings underscore the heightened practical value and promising prospects of the improved ELM model in electric load forecasting.

articleTitle: Construction of Manufacturing Data Acquisition System Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, industrial interconnection industrial has entered the era of many rules, many types of equipment, and many protocols, for the problem of real-time as well as diversity of data in the intelligent manufacturing system, this paper combines the edge computing to construct the production and manufacturing data acquisition system. By offloading part of the computational storage to the load side, the pressure on the service side is reduced, and the data transmission delay and reaction time are lowered. At the same time, through the deployment of load balancing in the edge end to achieve optimal collection, data extraction, data analysis and prediction, the data age calculation, the transmission delay and computation delay to achieve the optimal, to build the cloud edge-end collaboration. Combining the open-source framework of the Internet of Things and the edge gateway, and the edge-end optimization configuration of the terminal production and manufacturing data computation, storage, and network request, and uploading the processed data to the cloud, the cloud collaboratively senses the data update, and makes a reasonable decision on the lower level production, so as to construct the optimal system.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Used Car Export Monitoring Platform Based on Big Data Cloud Computing SAAS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to ensure the smooth implementation and efficient operation of China's second-hand car export business, this paper proposes a design and development method of second-hand car export monitoring platform based on big data cloud computing SAAS. Firstly, the business function of the system is designed around three modules: enterprise internal management module, information service module and external information release module. Secondly, based on cloud platform and SAAS model technology, it builds a five-level system framework composed of view layer, control layer, business support layer and data resource layer. Then, the system platform was tested according to the functional test, performance test, and security test; Finally, the test results show that the efficiency of the overall operation of the system platform basically meets the standards and requirements of the system online operation. The design and development of the platform ensure the smooth execution and efficient operation of the used car export business, and promote its development toward a more standardized and high-quality direction.

articleTitle: Blind Spot Detection System Merging Scene Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Blind Area Detection System (BSD) plays a positive role in reducing the occurrence of car accidents. In this paper, the test data of 15 vehicles passing through the C-NCAP (2021 edition) BSD C2C parallel road scene are selected, and the box diagram is used for statistical analysis. It is found that the alarm time TTC of most vehicles equipped with BSD system is reasonable at present, which plays a safety warning role and will not cause too much discomfort to users. However, the alarm timing of the BSD system of a few vehicles is not suitable enough, which still needs to be improved. In addition, when the lateral distance between the target vehicle and the own vehicle is too close, the BSD system should adopt a more urgent alarm mode to remind.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Photovoltaic Power Plant Layout Planning and System Efficiency in Waterworks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the layout planning problem of photovoltaic power station in waterworks, a layout planning algorithm based on multi-objective optimization is proposed. The algorithm is designed to maximize the power generation efficiency of photovoltaic power plants while minimizing their impact on waterworks operations and seeking a balance between land use efficiency and construction costs. Firstly, a multi-objective optimization model of photovoltaic power plant layout is established, which includes several optimization objectives such as power generation, shadow loss, land occupied area and economic cost. Then genetic algorithm is used as an optimization tool to optimize the layout of photovoltaic modules iteratively by simulating the biological evolution process. The experimental results show that the algorithm can significantly improve the overall power generation efficiency of photovoltaic power plants and reduce construction and operation costs while ensuring the normal operation of waterworks. This study provides an effective solution for the planning and design of photovoltaic power stations in waterworks, which has important theoretical significance and practical value for promoting the sustainable development of solar photovoltaic power stations.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data-Driven Network Security Threat Intelligence Analysis and Early Warning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid model combining static clustering algorithm and dynamic support vector machine (SVM) mechanism is proposed for the analysis and early warning of software malicious behavior. The model uses static clustering algorithm to classify massive threat intelligence data, extract key threat features, and then uses dynamic SVM mechanism to conduct fine analysis of clustering results to realize accurate identification and real-time early warning of malicious behaviors. Firstly, people construct a data set containing multiple threat intelligence sources, and extract the key indicators of software malicious behavior through feature engineering. Then K-means and other clustering algorithms are used to group these features and form a preliminary threat pattern. SVM algorithm was introduced to perform the secondary analysis of the clustering results, and through model training and verification, the detection ability of unknown threats was improved. The experimental results show that the model has high accuracy and low false positive rate in identifying malware behavior. This is especially true when dealing with large, high-dimensional data sets.

articleTitle: Research on the Application System of Deep Learning in English Remote Network Classroom
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focuses on the application of deep learning technology in English distance teaching, especially in the innovative practice of student face feature recognition. The study first constructed a dataset containing rich facial features for training deep learning models. The model can recognize a variety of basic expressions, such as happiness, sadness, surprise, and so on, and further resolve more subtle expression changes through complex network structures. In practical applications, the model is able to capture students' emotional feedback during the English learning process, thus providing teachers with intuitive data on student engagement and understanding. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the collected image data set can reach 99.99%, and the validity of the design method is verified by theoretical analysis and experiment. The expression recognition system based on deep learning has significant application value in English distance teaching.

articleTitle: Rice Quality Identification Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Rice is crucial for global food security and is among the most vital crops worldwide. Given its diverse types and characteristics, accurately classifying rice is essential for genetic improvement and rice breeding. Traditional methods and machine learning techniques for rice classification often fall short in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Hence, this paper proposes a rice type classification method based on convolutional neural network and transfer learning. The study utilizes the Rice Image Dataset, comprising 15,000 images per type across 5 rice varieties. Transfer learning is employed to reduce training costs, so we utilized pretrained models such as AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet18, MobileNetV2, and DenseNet121 to classify the dataset. Experimental results indicate that all five CNN models effectively classify rice types. However, MobileNetV2 stands out with the highest accuracy, F1-score, and kappa coefficient, along with the lowest parameters and floating-point operations (FLOPs), demonstrating superior accuracy and efficiency. These findings hold significant implications for selecting appropriate models in real-world agricultural applications, aiding in more precise rice classification.

articleTitle: A D3QN-APMA2C Design for Load Planning in Multi-Destination Airborne Combat
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Airborne combat, with its advantages of flexibility and rapid deployment, has become an important component of today's joint combat. Nonetheless, airborne combat are confronted with a multitude of challenges stemming from constraints such as limitations in transport aircrafts and airdrop missions. These constraints often lead to the inefficient utilization of transportation resources, suboptimal loading planning efficiency, and low levels of stability. In this paper, A D3QN-APMA2C algorithm has been proposed to improve the utilization rate of transportation forces and the success rate of loading planning. Based on a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, the D3QN term is used to determine the optimal transport force based on airdrop task information, while the APMA2C term is used to implement loading. The results showed that the success rate of loading planning using D3QN-APMA2C was 97.40%, and the space utilization rate of the transport plane in the obtained loading scheme was 96.62%, which was much higher than APMA2C and rule-based methods.

articleTitle: A Stable Model for Predicting Antiperiodic Boundary Value Problems of Pulsed Differential Equations Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the application of deep learning technology in predicting the stability of pulsed differential equations with antiperiodic boundary value problems. This theoretical result lays a solid foundation for the subsequent numerical simulation. Then, the deep learning framework is introduced into the construction of the model, and the neural network is trained with a large amount of historical data, so that it can capture the complex dynamic characteristics of the impulsive differential equation. In order to verify the validity of the proposed model, a systematic simulation experiment is carried out in this paper. The experimental results show that the deep learning model can not only effectively predict the stability of impulsive differential equations, but also show good robustness in the face of new input data. In addition, compared with the traditional numerical method, the proposed model also has significant advantages in computational efficiency. The deep learning model proposed in this paper provides an efficient and accurate new method for stability prediction of counter-periodic boundary value problems of pulsed differential equations, and has broad application prospects. Future work will further extend the applicability of the model and explore its potential value in a wider range of fields.

articleTitle: Research on Color Restoration Technology for Cantonese Manchurian Windows Combining Style Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article proposes a color restoration method that combines style attention mechanism to address the challenges encountered in the color restoration process of Cantonese Manchuria window images, such as color deviation caused by uneven lighting, loss of complex texture details, and image noise interference. By analyzing the high-level semantic features and low-level detail features of the backlit window image and the image to be processed, the original color of the Guangzhou Manchuria window is accurately restored while maintaining its fine texture structure. The experimental results show that this method significantly improves color restoration accuracy, image texture preservation, and reduces pseudo shadows.

articleTitle: The Method of Line Loss Analysis of Station Area Considering Multiple Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Abnormal line loss is a common problem in power grid operation, which directly affects the economy and efficiency of power grid. This paper aims to explore the factors leading to abnormal line loss in the station area. First, the station area is grouped by K-Means clustering algorithm, and the robust outliers detection algorithm is used to clean and screen the data indicators for different station groups. The station area with abnormal line loss is identified by the analysis of variance and partial correlation analysis to locate the main factors leading to abnormal line loss. This method can be widely used in the treatment of abnormal line loss in station area, providing theoretical support and practical guidance for power grid enterprises to reduce line loss and improve operation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Speech Recognition System for Oral English Evaluation using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper focuses on speech recognition algorithm based on bidirectional long short-term memory network combined with Connected Temporal classification (BiLSTM-CTC), aiming to improve the performance of spoken English evaluation system. The algorithm can improve the accuracy and robustness of speech recognition effectively by analyzing the English speech signals after pre-emphasis processing. Firstly, the original speech signal is preweighted to enhance the high frequency part and reduce the frequency resonance effect. Then Mayer frequency cepstrum coefficient (Fbank) is used as feature extraction method to capture the spectral characteristics of speech signals. The experimental results show that the amplitude of energy change of English speech signal after pre-accentuated is stable between-35dB and OdB, and the spectrum distribution is more balanced. This model has a significant improvement in recognition speed and accuracy. Especially in the complex background noise environment, the anti-interference ability of the new model is particularly outstanding, and the false recognition rate is effectively reduced. The speech recognition algorithm based on BiLSTM-CTC proposed in this paper not only optimizes the speech signal processing flow, but also greatly improves the overall performance of the recognition system.

articleTitle: Spatial Grid Algorithm in Aviation Control Area Division
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The partition stage in the traditional algorithms has lacked spatial utilization (low) and high computational complexity. Therefore, it can bring a series of problems. Therefore, some researchers have tried to explore more spatially efficient algorithms, such as a spatial grid algorithm (SGA), for the partition stage in air traffic control area. The SGA (or algorithm) is used to partition the aviation control area in this paper. As mentioned previously the SGA can partition areas by their grids or subregions, and some related operation constraints are considered and integrated. The algorithm is evaluated based on complexity, flexibility, and spatial utilization, and compared with traditional algorithms. The experiment results show SGA have a significant advantage for the partition of air control area. The SGA can be efficiently executed, has a fast partitioning rate compared to traditional algorithms, and has a significant computational efficiency advantage. It can make spatial resources in a regular pattern in the aviation control area and improve spatial utilization.

articleTitle: Development and Research of English Defect Reporting Software Based on Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore an innovative English defect reporting software that utilizes natural language processing (NLP) techniques, particularly hybrid neural networks and attention mechanisms, to improve the accuracy and readability of English defect reporting. The research focuses on English pronunciation defect recognition and aims to provide software developers with an intelligent defect report writing and review tool by integrating advanced algorithms and simulation techniques. Firstly, this study proposes an English pronunciation defect recognition model based on hybrid neural networks and attention mechanisms. The model uses deep learning algorithms to automatically identify and correct pronunciation errors in reports, while using attention mechanisms to improve the ability to capture key information in the text. This integrated approach effectively improves the language quality of defect reporting and reduces the communication barriers caused by language problems. Secondly, a comprehensive natural language processing system is developed, which not only includes the pronunciation defect recognition module, but also includes grammar checking, vocabulary suggestion and context understanding. Through the organic combination of these functions, the system can provide users with a full range of language support to ensure the professional and clear defect report. Finally, the simulation experiment of the system algorithm is carried out to evaluate its performance in practical application. The experimental results show that the developed system performs well in identifying pronunciation defects and providing language recommendations, significantly improving the quality of defect reporting.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of Computer Aided Ecolinguistic Learning Technology in English Intelligent Classroom System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the use of advanced resource retrieval algorithms under the framework of ecolinguistics theory, especially the KL-divergence retrieval model, to optimize the resource distribution and personalized learning path design of the English wisdom classroom system. Firstly, this paper introduces the basic concepts of ecolinguistics, emphasizing the dynamic and interactive nature of ecolinguistics learning. A CAELL framework combining the principles of ecolinguistics is proposed. The framework promotes students' acquisition of ecological language in interaction with computers by simulating the natural ecological language environment. Then, this paper analyzes the working mechanism of KL-divergence retrieval model, which can quantify the differences between different resources so as to accurately match students' learning needs. The research team constructed a prototype English wisdom classroom system and conducted a one-semester experiment to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The experimental results showed that students adopting CAELL technology and KL-divergence retrieval model were significantly better than those students adopting traditional teaching model in terms of vocabulary mastery, grammar application and oral communication. In addition, through the data mining and analysis of the learning process, the study also reveals the regularity of students' learning behavior, which provides a basis for further optimizing personalized learning strategies. The application of the computer-aided ecolingual learning technology and learning resource retrieval model in the intelligent English classroom system not only improves the teaching effect, but also provides a new way of thinking and practice for the future development of intelligent education.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Test of Intelligent Information System in Improving the Effect of Computer Aided Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The system uses the C/S mode design, the database Server uses Microsoft's SQL Server 2000 as the database, the client uses Visual Basic as the development language. Using OOP programming method, the auxiliary teaching software is studied in detail. A multimedia database service platform based on client /Server and Web is proposed to store multimedia information such as text, image, sound and animation. The main function of the VOD server is to store the user's image. Based on its functionality, it can be categorized into three main components: the multimedia content creation and input module, the curriculum planning and development module, and the educational networking module designed for course data creators, educators, and learners. This system can not only complete the routine CAI teaching, but also give students a platform for independent learning, so that teaching, independent learning and learning evaluation become a whole. The main research contents of this system include quantitative learning model, determining learning content, designing learning suggestions, designing system question answering and designing teaching practice. This system emphasizes the characteristics of learners' autonomous learning, so that individual learning can be brought into full play. It is the process by which learners acquire knowledge in learning.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of Algorithm for Translation Template Extraction Based on Sentence Comparison (ATTEBSC) in English Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the background of accelerating globalization, accurate and efficient language translation is very important for cross-cultural communication. In this paper, ATTEBSC (Algorithm for Translation Template Extraction Based on Sentence Comparison) is adopted, aiming at automatically extracting and comparing translation templates from large-scale text data by combining natural language processing technology and machine learning method. The specific methods include using deep learning framework to analyze sentence structure, using syntactic and semantic analysis tools to identify key translation units, and then extracting high-frequency and efficient translation templates through comparative analysis algorithm. In addition, ATTEBSC also introduces a dynamic updating mechanism, which can continuously optimize the translation template library according to new data input. Bleu (Bilingual Evaluation Under Study) scores in all fields are higher than 0.8, and TER is lower than 30%, which indicates that the translation quality of machine translation system in all fields is high. The research results show that ATTEBSC has obvious advantages in improving translation quality and efficiency, especially in dealing with professional or technical text translation, which can significantly improve translation accuracy and fluency.

Author Keywords: translation template extraction algorithm for sentence comparison

articleTitle: A CNN-Based Optical Music Recognition Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Optical Music Recognition (OMR) technology is an important means of music digitalization in the future. Today's society is developing in the direction of digitalization, virtualization, and intelligence, and the traditional music field is also deeply affected by it. In this paper, the OMR system mainly includes four parts: the preprocessing of music score images, the localization and deletion of spectral lines, the extraction and recognition of note motifs, and the reconstruction of music information. Finally, Pyqt5 is used to develop a complete system that is convenient for the input of score images, viewing descore images, text information, and playing audio to realize the conversion of scores. The extraction and recognition of note basis uses the direction gradient histogram and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) algorithm to train a model with high accuracy. The local connection, weight sharing, and pooling operation of CNN can effectively reduce the complexity of the network, reduce the number of training parameters, make the model have a certain degree of invariability to translation, distortion, and zoom, and have strong robustness and fault tolerance, and also be easy to train and optimize.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrocardiogram (ECG) Data Based On Random Forest And Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper presents a new hybrid model, termed Random Long Short Term Memory (RLST), which merges the Random Forest Algorithm's effective feature selection capability with the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network's potent capacity for modeling time series data, thereby introducing a novel methodology for the analysis of electrocardiogram (ECG) data. The model first uses random forests to extract the most discriminative features from complex ECG signals, which are then fed into the LSTM network for in-depth sequence learning to capture subtle patterns in the ECG signal over time. This comprehensive approach not only improves the recognition accuracy of ECG abnormalities, but also enhances the model's joint understanding of different ECG characteristics and time series dynamics, which brings significant performance improvement for heart health assessment and early diagnosis of disease.

articleTitle: Monte-Carlo Simulation of the Detection Performance for a Clearance Monitor with 4π Plastic Scintillators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Clearance of radioactive waste is part of the basic principles for radioactive waste management. An effective and accurate clearance check is urgently required for rapid and automatic batch analysis and classification. In this paper, we presented the design of a high-performance clearance monitor. The monitor chamber consists of 26 PS detectors with a high duty factor of about 92%. The shielding thickness of 75 cm lead with graded liners of copper and tin was adopted. The Monte-Carlo simulation was used to explore the background and detection efficiency characteristics. The background about 1810 cps could be achieved with scenarios of ambient y dose rate of For the typical ray of 662 keV emitted from 137CS, detection efficiencies of about 23.8% could be achieved. The corresponding MDCs for the typical radionuclides were typically below 0.1 mBq/g with counting time of 10 min, which is lower than 3-6 orders of magnitude for the clearance levels.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Low-rate DDoS Attacks Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Low-rate Distributed Denial-of-Service attacks, abbreviated as LDDoS, are experiencing an explosive and continuous growth in recent years. Meanwhile, people worked hard for making great contributions to prevent LDDoS attacks by deep learning methods. However, the existing surveys don't give detailed summaries on all aspects of neural network for LDDoS attacks. This paper investigates the trend and the challenges of LDDoS attacks. And then, it classifies the neural network methods into DL-based cluster, RL-based cluster, FL-based cluster and GNN-based cluster. And it presents the comprehensive survey along with state-of-the-art detection solutions for each of them. At last, the future research directions about developing an LDDoS detection system with broad-spectrum capabilities, cost-effective mechanisms and robustness against adversarial attacks are given.

articleTitle: RCS Weighted Filtering Method Suppresses Target Angle Flicker
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The relationship between RCS and target Angle flicker was established, and the calculation model of angle flicker suppression by weighted filter algorithm is established. The model is used to process and compare the simulation data and the measured data respectively, the results shows that the target RCS weighting method is suitable for suppressing target angular flicker. The angle measurement accuracy of radar can be improved by using RCS weighting method. The results show that the method can accurately determine the moment of extinction of the bottom row of projectiles. The method can also be used to determine the moment of ignition or extinction of other types of projectiles.

articleTitle: Research on Clinical Trial Data Analysis Based on Bayesian Network and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper delves into an innovative approach to analyzing clinical trial data by harnessing the power of Bayesian networks and deep learning methods, particularly in combination with convolutional neural networks (CNN). This fusion of techniques allows the meticulous extraction of valuable features from complex data sets by applying the convolution and pooling operations of CNN. The extracted features are then carefully modeled using Bayesian networks, facilitating the construction of complex relationships between various variables. This methodological framework is particularly good at dissecting and interpreting nuances in clinical trial data. The empirical results shown in the study highlight the model's superior predictive power, particularly in estimating coronary blood flow. This advanced technique offers a significant improvement in prediction accuracy compared to traditional models.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Landscape Design of Urban Public Space
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The study focused on the realization of virtual reality landscape effects, using Triangulation Irregular network (TIN) model simulation technology to accurately capture subtle changes in urban terrain, creating a highly realistic virtual working environment for designers. This study also proposes an urban landscape image acquisition algorithm based on 3D laser scanning, which can efficiently extract complex urban landscape data from the real world and seamlessly integrate it into virtual reality. This algorithm not only improves the efficiency of data acquisition, but also ensures the accuracy and authenticity of landscape performance in virtual reality environment. Through case analysis, this study finds that the combination of virtual reality technology and advanced image acquisition algorithms can significantly enhance the interaction between designers and urban space, making the design decision-making process more intuitive and dynamic.

articleTitle: Research and Application Based on Probability Statistics and Gaussian Mixture Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper synthesises the in-depth study and extensive practical application of the principles of probabilistic statistics and the Gaussian mixture clustering (GMM) algorithm with the aim of revealing the powerful efficacy of the algorithm in dealing with complex data structures. By reviewing the theoretical foundations of Gaussian Mixture Models, this study firstly describes their central role in probability density estimation and how efficient learning of model parameters can be achieved by the Expectation Maximisation (EM) algorithm. Further, the thesis provides an in-depth analysis of algorithm performance optimisation strategies, including but not limited to the selection of initialisation methods, the setting of convergence criteria and model selection criteria, to cope with the challenges posed by large-scale datasets and high-dimensional data.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization and Route Planning for Multibeam Bathymetric Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
