abstract: Multibeam bathymetric systems are employed in deep-sea terrain exploration due to the minimal attenuation of acoustic wave propagation, which decreases further at lower frequencies. The use of wireless signals facilitates collaborative communication and multi-dimensional sensing, thereby inferring the relevant characteristics of the target. However, unknown changes in the sea area consume energy for vessel navigation. Employing sensing technology for target feature recognition along with multibeam detection concurrently reduces the energy consumed by vessel navigation, thus achieving optimal resource allocation. First, the seabed slope measurement angle is calculated using the sine theorem. Next, the beam detection coverage width and its strip coverage are modeled. Finally, the vessel sailing direction is optimized to achieve the shortest sailing distance while ensuring the accuracy of the beam coverage width. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm improves the accuracy of the coverage width, reduces coverage width leakage, lowers the strip overlap rate, and realizes the goal of minimum energy consumption for vessel navigation while ensuring sensing accuracy in underwater communication.

articleTitle: Detection of Mosquito in Print Dirty Spot Defect Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Dirty spot is the most common type of defect in print defect detection, and some dirty spots may be caused by mosquitoes. For food packaging, the appearance of mosquitoes on the packaging is a very serious matter, so it is necessary to carry out special testing to eliminate the appearance of mosquitoes in food packaging. Mosquito detection is of great significance for ensuring the quality of printed matter, ensuring food safety, maintaining corporate brand image and reputation, and reducing production costs and economic losses. Based on the needs of mosquito detection, combined with the characteristics of small target size of mosquito and complex background in printed matter, in this paper mosquito is detected by a deep learning detection method based on YOLOv7. Through the analysis and processing of a large number of print image data, the accurate and efficient detection of mosquito in print dirty spot defect is realized.

articleTitle: Semantic Understanding in Natural Language Processing: Application of Graph Neural Networks in Relationship Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Semantic understanding in the prospects of natural language processing (NLP) is designed to interpret and comprehend the meaning of the prospects of text beyond words. A fundamental application of the systems revolves around relationship extraction, designed to play a fundamental role in identifying and categorizing semantic relationships between entities and text. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to this effect are considered powerful tools within this domain that help model complex and relational data. The representation of texts into graphs through nodes that correspond to the input words signifies the syntactic and semantic relationships drawn through NLP. GNNs, therefore helping capture contextual and intricate dependencies and information through a process that enhances the extraction accuracy mainly by leveraging on the structural properties of the system. Semantic understanding in NLP, therefore handles different elements that include the non-sequential systems of language that help integrate information in varied document prospects. Therefore, this article seems to draw an understanding of NLP through applying GNN in relationship extraction. Findings established that GNNs in relationship extraction remain a promising development contributing to the accurate and sophisticated semantic understanding of NLP.

articleTitle: Application Research of Operation and Maintenance Scene Fusion and Intelligent Knowledge Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligent level of power measuring equipment operation and maintenance, this paper introduces intelligent knowledge assistance technology into the reconstruction of power measuring equipment maintenance and operation scenario. The scene view of power measuring equipment operation is fused by vector library. A 3D vision imaging model based on machine vision was established. The feature of operation and maintenance scene is extracted by using fuzzy degree detection and visual reconstruction, and three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out by intelligent knowledge assistant technology. This paper uses pixel-based image fusion and virtual reality rendering techniques to enhance visual information in the operating environment. Multiple view images are encoded with the corresponding camera parameters and attitude information. According to the power metering device operation and maintenance scenario, the spatial distribution set is reorganized to achieve 3D VR vision reconstruction optimization. Simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can reproduce the running state of electric energy measuring equipment quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Perception and Reliable Transmission of Marine Environmental Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The research analyzes the needs of efficient data perception and reliable transmission from the perspective of marine environmental monitoring. At the same time, we integrate wireless sensor networks and Mesh networks, and build multi-sensor heterogeneous wireless ad hoc networks to solve technical problems such as efficient data perception and reliable transmission in complex marine environments. We closely focus on key technical contents such as multi-sensor marine environment detection models, environment-sensitive wireless sensor network MAC protocols, cross-layer and geographical location-assisted routing protocols. The research results have great application value and social benefits for marine economic development and marine environmental protection. The proposed models, protocols and solutions also have strong academic significance for promoting the development of wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Research on Immersive Experience System of Virtual Reality Technology in College Physical Education Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focuses on the innovative application of virtual reality (VR) technology in college physical education teaching, and designs and implements an immersive experience system, aiming to improve the learning effect and training quality of students through the advanced 3D sports auxiliary training system and sports action recognition algorithm. The system uses high-performance VR headsets and whole-body tracking devices to build a highly realistic virtual training environment, enabling students to learn and practice sports skills in simulated real scenes. This study developed a motion recognition algorithm based on deep learning, which can accurately capture and analyze students' motion posture, provide feedback in real time, and help students adjust their movements in time to meet the standard requirements. The algorithm can recognize and classify complex movements with high precision by training a lot of movement data. In order to verify the effectiveness of the system, simulation experiments are carried out in this study. The experimental results show that compared with traditional teaching methods, students using immersive experience system have a significant improvement in the speed of sports skills and movement accuracy. The system not only enhances students' sense of immersion and participation, but also promotes the rapid progress and standardization of students' motor skills through personalized training feedback.

articleTitle: Research on Visual and Text Information Fusion Algorithm in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore a new visual and text information fusion algorithm, which can effectively improve the accuracy and efficiency of sentiment analysis by combining the advantages of the trusted fine-grained alignment model and the Faster R-CNN algorithm. First, this paper proposes a visual object detection mechanism based on Faster R-CNN algorithm, which can accurately identify and locate key emotion expression elements in images. Then, the alignment model is used to associate the visual object with the corresponding text description, and the cross-modal information fusion is realized. This fusion not only considers the explicit emotional cues of visual information, but also digs deeply into the implicit emotional tendencies in the text, thus providing more comprehensive and detailed emotional analysis results. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, a series of simulation experiments are designed and tested on several public data sets. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional single-modal analysis method, the fusion algorithm proposed in this paper significantly improves the performance of emotion classification tasks, especially when dealing with complex emotion expression and ambiguous text, showing stronger robustness and adaptability. The research results of this paper not only provide a new technical path in the field of multi-modal sentiment analysis, but also provide more reliable technical support for related application scenarios such as product review analysis and social media public opinion monitoring.

articleTitle: Dynamic Programming Algorithm for Optimizing Flight Altitude Adjustment Strategies in Air Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the case of continuous high density, all types of airspace are not effectively utilized, and at the same time there are some airspace divisions that are unreasonable, which leads to the aircraft not being able to follow the predetermined routes. The FPL (flight plan) altitude is determined by the flight crew according to various factors, such as the weight of the aircraft, the route distance and the wind field at high altitude. The FPL (fight plan) altitude is decided by the crew according to the weight of the airplane, the distance of the route, and the wind field at high altitude, etc. Fuel consumption is relatively low when flying at this altitude. Unreasonable flight altitude not only increases fuel consumption, but also causes serious pollution to the environment. In this paper, an optimization method based on DRL (Deep Reinforcement Learning) algorithm for dynamic planning is proposed. By constructing a multi-stage decision-making model, the optimal flight altitude adjustment strategy is designed by comprehensively considering the factors of flight safety, airway congestion and meteorological conditions. The final system response time experiments show the efficiency and stability of the DRL algorithm in complex decision-making environments, which is suitable for real aviation control optimization.

articleTitle: Integrated Dynamic Modeling and Reinforcement Learning for Position Prediction and Search and Rescue of Deep-Sea Submersibles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, a combination of dynamic and stochastic perturbation models is proposed for the deep-sea submersible position prediction problem. The position prediction model is established by studying the main forces of the submersible, such as propulsion, water friction, and seabed friction, as well as the influence of ocean currents on its operation. For the selection of rescue equipment, the AHP method is applied to assess the importance of the equipment, and the equipment combinations of the main vessel and the rescue vessel are determined by integer linear programming. Further, reinforcement learning is used to optimize the search and rescue path selection and maximize the probability of successful search and rescue. The paper also considers the possibility of extending the model to other tourist destinations by introducing current models and velocity sensors to address the response in case of multi-submersible operations and failures.

articleTitle: Research on Information Service Platform Based on Flex Technology and REST Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the guidance of the rural revitalization strategy, in order to realize the unified management of multi-village affairs and the sharing and scheduling of information resources, this paper builds a new rural community integrated management and information service platform based on Flex technology and REST architecture style. The platform adopts the distributed multi-layer structure mode, aiming to improve the modernization level of rural information management. First of all, this paper elaborates the overall architecture of the platform, including the front-end rich Internet application (RIA) interface design and the back-end RESTful service interface, to ensure the openness and scalability of the system. Then, the paper reviews the technical path of the platform, and emphasizes the advantages of Flex technology in creating interactive client applications with good user experience. At the same time, the key technologies of the platform such as spatial data model and workflow are deeply analyzed to ensure the accuracy of information and the efficiency of the process. Through the practical application mode and the test example, this paper shows the remarkable effect of this platform in realizing the automatic management of community information. The platform can not only provide complex user experience, but also effectively improve the operating efficiency and response speed of the system, and meet the diversified needs of new rural communities in information resource scheduling and transaction processing.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Ceramic Product Design Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The design of ceramic products is a crucial and complex process, and the traditional design process has certain drawbacks in product design. This article put forward a ceramic product design intelligent system based on multiple linear regression models to increase the design accuracy and efficiency. The basic model of ceramic product design intelligent system was introduced as multiple regression model. Based on ceramic product design data in large quantities as the learning and modeling data, the designed system can fully consider the relationship and effect among several design variables. The experiments results showed that the accuracy of ceramic product design intelligent system based on multiple linear regression models was better than the original design manner, and the system provided innovative design solutions that were tailored to practical needs and requirements. The system allows designers to consider the effects of multiple factors comprehensively and effectively, thus offering more accurate, innovative, and more market-demanding design solutions for designers, and the system is likely to make a significant contribution to the development and innovation of ceramic product design.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Optimization of a Four-Bit Absolute Comparator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, AI large models are becoming more and more popular. This is followed by an increasing demand for graphics card computing power. There are many areas in the graphics card, such as image and video processing, 3D rendering. These areas need to process a large amount of data, in order to reduce the computing power consumed by the graphics card. People can use the comparator for edge detection and threshold processing or noise removal, filtering waveform and so on. The purpose of this paper is to make a four-bit absolute comparator. In this paper, a four-bit absolute value comparator is made by circuit principle and truth table and the circuit is simplified by formula simplification method to make the logic circuit more concise. And through MATLAB simulation test, we successfully realized the function. Finally, through the critical path, changing the size of the logic gates and Vdd input increases the delay to some extent but corresponds to a significant reduction in energy loss. After optimization, the energy loss is reduced by 48.13% to 38.40 J at 1.5 times delay.

articleTitle: Research on Sailboat Price Prediction Based on LS-SVM Prediction Algorithm and XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper investigates the prediction of sailboat prices using the LS-SVM prediction algorithm and the XGBoost algorithm. The study involves training prediction models, determining coefficients of determination, and calculating the mean absolute error (MAE) for both LS-SVM and SVM algorithms, resulting in values of 0.99143, 0.89572, and 0.94512, respectively. The LS-SVM model demonstrated the highest predictive accuracy. Additionally, a regional impact model incorporating the XGBoost algorithm was introduced. Data from each region was utilized to predict the performance of second-hand sailboats, serving as the training set for the model. The study culminated in the derivation of the solution model through the XGBoost algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Simplified Method for 3D Reconstruction of Grid Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction technology plays a crucial role in various fields, especially in civil engineering, where it is essential for the monitoring and management of infrastructure such as buildings, bridges, and roads. This paper presents a simplified 3D reconstruction method specifically designed for large-span and high-precision grid structures. The method reduces computational complexity and enhances reconstruction accuracy by describing grid structure nodes with only four basic parameters: three spatial coordinates and a radius parameter. Utilizing image data captured by Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and combined with deep learning algorithms, this study successfully achieved high-precision 3D reconstruction of a partial grid structure in a sports stadium in Hebei. Additionally, this paper reviews single-image 3D reconstruction methods based on deep learning, UAS-assisted 3D reconstruction techniques, and the application and challenges of 3D reconstruction technology in civil engineering. Finally, the paper discusses future research directions, including enhancing algorithm robustness, processing large-scale data, fusing multi-source data, and developing real-time reconstruction systems.

articleTitle: Ideas and Simulation Analysis of UAV Multi-Dimensional Trajectory Strategy Based on an Optimized Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To address challenges such as excessively long trajectories, susceptibility to local optima, and low convergence efficiency encountered by traditional ant colony algorithms in designing UA V multi-dimensional trajectories, this paper proposes an optimized version of the ant colony algorithm. In this proposed strategy, we innovatively integrate altitude factors into the algorithm's heuristic function to guide ant colonies in goal-oriented searches. The dynamic adjustment of pheromone update rates, pheromone influence, and expected influence with iteration enhances global exploration capabilities, prevents local optima trapping, and improves convergence speed. Simulation experiments confirm the effectiveness and practicality of this optimized ant colony algorithm for UA V multi-dimensional trajectory strategies using grid-based strategy implementation in a multi-dimensional space.

articleTitle: Research on Data-Driven Financial Risk Prediction Model Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article aims to explore a data-driven financial risk prediction model based on cloud computing technology. This model achieves accurate identification and prediction of corporate financial risks by integrating advanced algorithms and knowledge graph technology. This article proposes a new risk prediction algorithm model that combines multiple methods such as machine learning, deep learning, and statistical analysis to learn patterns from historical data and predict future financial risks. In addition, the application of knowledge graph enables the model to better understand the internal connections of financial data and improve the accuracy of predictions. Finally, through system simulation experiments, this paper verifies the effectiveness and stability of the proposed model in practical applications. Experimental results show that this model can significantly improve the accuracy of financial risk prediction and provide powerful decision support for enterprises. This research not only enriches the theoretical system in the field of financial risk management, but also provides new ideas and technical means for the practice of financial risk management and control of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Search Based on Improved 3D Metacellular Automata Model and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the position prediction problem of submersible after signal loss is studied deeply, and a prediction model which can simulate underwater complex environment is constructed by using improved 3D cellular automata model and genetic algorithm. Firstly, the detailed analysis of the Ionian Sea current and seabed topography provides a scientific basis for the position prediction of the submersible. Secondly, based on the principle of cellular automata, three-dimensional models including water cells, diving cells and soil cells are constructed. By setting different cell properties and evolution rules, the underwater trajectory and staying position of the submersible are simulated. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the model are verified through simulation experiments, which provides strong support for the follow-up search and rescue operations. This research not only provides a new method for the position prediction of submersible, but also provides a new idea and technical means for underwater search and rescue.

articleTitle: Research on Business Incubator Evaluation System Based on Support Vector Machine and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the evaluation system of business incubator based on support vector machine and machine learning. Firstly, in view of the complexity and multi-dimensional characteristics of incubator evaluation, an evaluation framework was proposed that comprehensively considered the operational efficiency, service quality, innovation ability and market performance of incubators. Then, by collecting a large amount of incubator data, support vector machine is used for feature extraction and classification modeling, and the evaluation system model is built. The results show that the model can accurately evaluate the comprehensive performance of incubators and effectively identify the advantages and disadvantages of incubator operation. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the evaluation system were verified by practical cases, which provided scientific decision-making basis for incubator managers and investors and promoted the healthy development of the incubator industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction System of Learning Outcome Certification System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to explore a blockchain-based learning outcomes certification system to improve the transparency, security and efficiency of educational certification. Firstly, this paper analyzes the problems existing in the existing learning achievement certification system, such as easy tampering, centralized risk and cumbersome operation, and then proposes to use the decentralized and immutable characteristics of blockchain to solve these problems. In the process of system construction, this research pays special attention to the optimization of consensus algorithm. Aiming at the performance bottleneck of traditional Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) algorithm under high load, an improved BFT consensus algorithm is proposed. By introducing dynamic node selection mechanism and asynchronous communication protocol, the throughput and response speed of the system are significantly improved. The design of the learning results certification management system follows the modular principle, which is divided into four modules: identity verification, achievement record, certification audit and inquiry service. Each module is automatically managed using smart contracts, ensuring immutable data and transparent operations. The system also supports cross-institutional certification, providing learners with a unified and trusted certification platform. Simulation results show that the optimized BFT consensus algorithm can greatly improve the processing capacity of the system while maintaining security.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Abnormal Data Based on Deep Learning and Improved Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Given the rapid growth of emerging systems and technologies, cloud systems of computing, IoT, and other massive data applications, as viewed in this case, are trying to cross thresholds in value realization and real-time analysis. This makes the element of data streams ubiquitous within different industries. Given this, the need for the detection of anomalies within these cohorts of data streams may play a fundamental role in avoiding the risks that come with limiting decision-making. The traditional methods of anomaly and abnormal data algorithms widely relied on acquiring information from a pool of data globally, a factor that made it significantly challenging to streamline and apply the data to different scenarios. However, significant reviews on algorithms within the domain of abnormal or anomaly data detection widely focus on using and exposing data anomalies through learning and improved algorithms, establishing the rationale behind this article. Therefore, this article focuses on detecting and classifying abnormal data based on deep learning and improved algorithms in static and different data environments.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Technology in the Information System of College Students' Entrepreneurship Training
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the traditional computer-supported education and training system, such as single user structure, poor immersion and inability to support collaboration, this project carried out research on the skill cultivation system based on collaborative virtual environment. The architecture and workflow are designed with the idea of hierarchical architecture. This paper studies the object- oriented collaborative virtual training scenario design method. Through the communication of parallel server, a collaborative working environment of multiple users is established. In the cooperative sensor system, the real-time collection and transmission of the time sequence information of the nodes can reduce the load of the system. A dynamic network iterative evolutionary clustering method for E-Learning training is established based on evolutionary clustering and the compilation and decoding of search results. The simulation results show that this method can satisfy the user's real-time query requirement. At the same time, the vector electronic drawing board is combined with the text information transmission technology to realize the instant comments to teachers and the instant comments to many people. The practicability of this method and its advantages over conventional CBT are illustrated by a concrete engineering example.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Computer-assisted French Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the growth of globalized educational needs, traditional language teaching methods are facing many challenges and new educational technologies are urgently needed to enhance teaching effectiveness and efficiency. This study aims to design and implement an efficient computer-assisted French teaching system. Based on the educational needs, this paper analyzes in depth the current problems and needs in French language teaching, and determines the basic needs of the system through investigation and data analysis. The paper describes in detail the design ideas and implementation strategies of the system architecture, including user interface design, back-end logic processing and database management, with special emphasis on the design principles of interactivity and user-friendliness. In terms of technical realization, the current popular Web development technology and database technology are adopted to ensure that the system has good operability and expandability. During the implementation of the system, a series of tests, including functional tests, performance tests and user acceptance tests, are conducted to ensure stable operation and good user experience. For the real-time chat function, the average user response time is 2.2 seconds, showing an efficient immediate response capability, which helps users to communicate with each other smoothly. This study provides important reference value and practical guidance for the design of future language teaching systems, especially in providing new perspectives and methods for effectively integrating technical support and teaching needs.

articleTitle: The Dissemination Trend of Tang Poetry Based on ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper investigates the changes in the dissemination trends of Tang poetry before and after the COVID-19 pandemic, employing the ARIMA model for time series forecasting due to the scarcity of multivariate data. Through web crawling technology, the Baidu Index data of Tang poetry from October 1, 2019, to April 1, 2020, were collected to reflect the popularity and dissemination intensity of Tang poetry. In the process of model construction, the data were first subjected to a stationarity test, and differential and logarithmic transformations were applied to ensure the stationarity of the data. Subsequently, the parameters of the ARIMA model were determined based on the Partial Autocorrelation Function (PACF) and Autocorrelation Function (ACF) plots. The model was trained using the training set data, and its predictive performance on the test set was evaluated using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). The results indicate that the ARIMA model, despite the absence of effective external variables, can effectively fit and predict the dissemination trends of Tang poetry. Compared to a linear regression model, the ARIMA model demonstrates significant advantages in prediction accuracy. This study not only reveals the impact of the pandemic on the dissemination of Tang poetry but also provides a valuable reference for future predictions of similar cultural dissemination trends.

articleTitle: Prediction of Flight Delays Based on the XGboost Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low prediction accuracy on large dataset samples, this paper proposes the use of the XGBoost model, which uses an exact greedy algorithm and an approximation algorithm to find the feature segmentation point that minimises the loss function and integrates multiple weak learners, and accumulates the difference between the prediction result and the target value of each learner to achieve the improvement of the whole model. XGBoost uses parallel computing and caching techniques, which can significantly improve the training speed and outperform other models on large-scale datasets. In this paper, we use the XGBoost model to predict the flight dataset and use the grid search method for hyper-parameter tuning, which effectively improves the accuracy of the model prediction.

articleTitle: Initial Disturbance Convergence Analysis Method of Control System Based on UAV Route Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the process of autonomous planning of VAV routes, due to the imperfection of the system, there will inevitably be the phenomenon of initial value disturbance, which will seriously affect the operational performance and efficiency of the VAV route planning system. In order to solve the unnecessary influence of the initial value disturbance in the iterative learning control system, this paper proposes a class of fractional-order linear systems, and proposes a new frequency domain and convergence analysis method by using the shrinkage mapping principle, and gives a digital simulation verification to prove the feasibility of the above concept.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Unmanned Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, artificial intelligence has been widely used in all walks of life. Unmanned driving is the mainstream of the future automobile industry. With the help of artificial intelligence, unmanned driving will gradually move towards real unmanned driving. Based on the concept of artificial intelligence technology and unmanned vehicle, combined with the current application status of unmanned vehicle, this paper analyzes the specific application of artificial intelligence in unmanned vehicle, and analyzes the problems existing in the application of unmanned vehicle at present, and looks forward to the development trend of unmanned vehicle in the future, which provides reference for the mature application of unmanned vehicle technology.

articleTitle: Single Objective Optimization of Heliostat Field Efficiency in Tower Power Plants Based on Monte Carlo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper established a single objective nonlinear tower heliostat field optimization design model based on the principle of solar rays entering and exiting, coordinate transformation, etc. It uses traversal algorithm, improved Monte Carlo algorithm, improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, etc. to solve the problem, and finally obtains the relevant data parameters of the heliostat field. The paper introduces a shadow occlusion judgment matrix, which projects related heliostats onto the ground plane. Monte Carlo algorithm is used to scatter points onto the ground plane, eliminating random points affected by occlusion and shadow judgment matrix. This is used to calculate the efficiency of shadow occlusion, which has great reference value for designing and controlling heliostat fields.

articleTitle: Security Architecture Design and Implementation Challenges of Software Defined Network in Industrial Internet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The application of Software Defined Network (SDN) in the industrial internet environment faces many security challenges, including the expansion of attack surface, the centralized risk of the control plane, and the potential vulnerabilities of the north-south interface. In order to analyze these problems in depth, this work first analyzes the existing industrial internet security threats and the application status of SDN in the security field. Secondly, this work designs and implements an SDN security architecture model, including the control layer, data layer, and application layer. This work focuses on traffic monitoring, threat detection, and response mechanisms. The simulation environment of industrial internet is established by using Mininet simulation tool, which is used to simulate actual network traffic and attack scenarios in industrial Internet. Various types of attacks are introduced, including Denial of Service, Man-In-The-Middle, and the defense and recovery capabilities of the SDN architecture are tested under different attack intensities. Finally, through the simulation experiment platform, the performance of the designed SDN architecture in the actual industrial Internet environment is comprehensively evaluated, and the threat detection is optimized based on the Random Forest Algorithm. Quantitative analysis is conducted using Key Performance Indicators such as network latency, throughput, and security event response time. The research results indicate that the SDN architecture can effectively control the growth of network latency and security event response time under different attack intensities. Meanwhile, the SDN architecture also shows advantages in maintaining network throughput, with a throughput reduction ratio controlled within 10% under high-intensity attacks. In addition, the threat detection model based on the random forest algorithm achieves around 90% accuracy, recall, and F1 score, demonstrating its efficiency and universality in threat detection. This work proves the potential advantages and practical application value of SDN in the field of industrial internet security, but also points out some challenges in actual deployment, such as system complexity and resource consumption.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Coordinated Configuration of Microgrid Wind and Storage Based on Combinatorial Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the optimization of the coordinated allocation of landscape storage in the park microgrid. By using the combination optimization method and economic analysis model, an effective allocation scheme is proposed. First, by constructing economic indicators including photovoltaic power purchase, wind power purchase and main grid power purchase, the optimal strategy of independent operation and configuration of energy storage in the park is analyzed in detail. Secondly, for the three parks A, B and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{C}$</tex>, the economic benefits of 50kW/100kWh energy storage are calculated respectively, and the typical daily load curve of each park and the image of power purchase (abandoned power) of the main grid are obtained through MATLAB programming, further revealing the key factors affecting the economy. Finally, based on the above analysis, the optimal operation plan of each park after the configuration of energy storage is solved, which provides specific and effective guidance for the coordinated configuration of wind and scenery storage of the park microgrid.

articleTitle: Prediction Technology of Ocean Acidification Based on Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization and Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the ocean acidification prediction problem was studied deeply, and a new prediction model was constructed by using quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm (QPSO) and long short-term memory neural network (LSTM). Firstly, by introducing the quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm, the limitations of the traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm in search accuracy and global search ability are overcome, and the convergence speed and prediction accuracy of the model are improved. Secondly, using the ability of long short-term memory neural network to process time series data, it effectively captures the long-term dependence relationship in ocean acidification data, and further enhances the prediction ability of the model. Finally, through a series of experimental verification and performance evaluation, including root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) and coefficient of determination (R2), it is proved that the model has high accuracy and generalization ability in ocean acidification prediction. The model provides a new method for the effective prediction of ocean acidification.

articleTitle: Tennis Ball Momentum Study Based on LSTM Neural Network and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper examines the assessment of tennis player performance and the dynamics of match dynamics through a comprehensive statistical analysis. It employs Spearman's correlation and Fisher's discriminant analysis to develop a performance assessment model that incorporates first serve rate, second serve rate, and unforced errors as key performance indicators. In addition, this paper employs an LSTM neural network prediction model to elucidate the fluctuating effects of momentum on tennis game production. Then, Mann-Kendall mutation test was utilized for identifying momentum turning point changes and related influences during matches, and subsequent random forest analysis revealed the significant effects of serve, double faults, and match streaks on match outcomes. Better yet, momentum effects are analyzed against match outcomes to assess whether the model is purely applicable for a variety of matches and provide insights into potential model enhancements.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Psychological Health Assessment System for College Students Based on Machine Learning and Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Over the recent years, the psychological wellness and health of college students has turned out as a growing issue and concern, a factor that is attributed to the increase in pressures in balancing social challenges, academic life, and the transition made through adulthood. To this effect, the traditional approaches and models of psychological assessment as viewed in this case are widely static, unable to meet the dynamic nature of the learner's mental health, and time consuming. To effectively address these challenges, an effective psychological health assessment tool and system leverages the prospects of intelligent algorithm and machine learning as proposed in this article. The system provides personalized and real-time evaluations to learner's psychological issues and states through an analysis of data inputs that span from self-reported metrices, academic performances, and social interactions. Machine learning and intelligent algorithms as found in this article widely help in the detection and prediction of patterns that show the potential of psychological issues among learners, helping in establishing early supportive and interventive measures. As proposed, the continuous adoption of individual changes through intelligent algorithms and machine learning provides a timely and accurate understanding of the learner's mental states, a process that promotes learners wellness, academic success, and fosters a supporting coping environment.

articleTitle: Study on Automatic Recording and Health Promotion System of University Sports Results
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to develop a set of automatic recording and health promotion system for college sports. The system uses the classification model based on support vector machine (SVM) to evaluate the health status of college students, and combines the evaluation results with the physical performance records to realize the dynamic monitoring and management of students' physical activity and health status. By integrating smart wearable devices, the system collects physiological data of students in real time, and uses SVM algorithm for data analysis to predict and classify the health risk level of students. At the same time, the system has designed a user-friendly interface for teachers to record and manage students' physical education results, ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of data. In order to verify the effectiveness of the system, detailed algorithm design and simulation experiments are carried out in this study. The experimental results show that the proposed SVM-based health assessment model has high accuracy and reliability in identifying potential health problems. In addition, the automated function of the sports performance recording system significantly improves the efficiency of data management and reduces the occurrence of human error.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Learning Path Planning Algorithm in Intelligent Education Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Personalized learning paths are fundamental in saving students learning time, an aspect that significantly improves the learning process through appropriate and effective learning models. The contemporary models designed for personalized learning paths primarily focus on knowledge structures and learner characteristics, a factor that significantly ignores the element of critical roles in establishing learning models. In response to these challenges, this study proposes a dynamic model of a personalized learning path that relies on planning algorithms for online learners. The proposed and designed model computes the difficulties of establishing proper knowledge constructs and points, which help address knowledge challenges in the model. Therefore, learning path algorithms are used to normalize the learning process. This factor establishes the need for novel approaches that may be used to automate education management systems. Thus, this experiment revealed that the personalized learning path model designed through a planning algorithm effectively generates a personalized learning model. The findings establish that a customized learning path planning algorithm may improve learning efficiency, effective learning behavior, and course completion rates.

articleTitle: Research on User Recommendation Algorithm Based on Global Auto Parts Price Sensing Database
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to develop a user recommendation algorithm based on the global auto parts price perception database to improve the efficiency and accuracy of users' purchase decisions. The algorithm enables personalized recommendations by monitoring and analyzing global auto parts price changes in real time, combined with the user's historical purchasing behavior and personal preferences. Firstly, this paper proposes a price sensing mechanism, which can capture the price differences between different regions and different suppliers, and integrate and analyze these information through big data technology. Then this paper designs a set of user recommendation algorithm, which not only considers the price factor, but also integrates multi-dimensional information such as the quality of accessories, user evaluation and market trend. The core of the algorithm is to use collaborative filtering and machine learning techniques to predict the needs of users and provide customized product recommendations. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, extensive simulation experiments are carried out in this paper. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional recommendation system, the proposed algorithm has significant advantages in improving user experience and transaction conversion rate.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordinated Configuration of Wind-Solar-Storage in Campus Microgrids Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focuses on the coordinated configuration of wind, solar, and energy storage systems within microgrids, leveraging the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to achieve optimal energy management. With the increasing emphasis on renewable energy due to environmental concerns and energy crises, integrating wind and solar power into microgrids is vital. However, the intermittent nature of these energy sources can lead to supply-demand fluctuations, necessitating effective energy storage solutions. The research involves three campus microgrids, A, B, and C, each with distinct photovoltaic (PV) and wind power capacities. Utilizing the PSO algorithm, the paper establishes an optimization model that considers energy generation, load demands, charging and discharging dynamics, and economic constraints to determine the optimal configuration for energy storage systems. The model aims to minimize the total power supply cost while ensuring a balance between energy production and consumption. The results indicate that the coordinated configuration of wind, solar, and storage systems significantly reduces the reliance on the main power grid and decreases the total cost of electricity. The study also compares the independent and joint operation plans, highlighting the economic benefits of a joint operation strategy, which is expected to save approximately 231 million yuan over five years compared to independent operation.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Risk Management System of Credit Scoring Mechanism Driven by Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, combined with cloud computing technology, the overall structure of enterprise credit evaluation system is given, and its database is introduced in detail. The working process of each system is described in detail and the concrete implementation scheme is put forward. This project intends to use Monte Carlo simulation to divide the data of each credit grade into several subclasses, and use the unpredictability of the same subclass assets to obtain the maximum loss of each subclass assets. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively calculate the value of credit risk. The practical application proves that the enterprise credit information system established on the cloud platform has the characteristics of easy updating and easy maintenance. This system provides a reference for the government organs, banks and enterprises to formulate and implement incentive policies. It enhances the prevention and protection of the credit risk of enterprises and promotes the sustainable and healthy development of enterprises.

articleTitle: Beyond Heuristics: Multimodal Transformer for Chart Data Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Extracting data from charts is a crucial task for comprehending their content and facilitating subsequent tasks. Rule-based methods have conventionally been used to extract data from various chart types. However, these heuristic-driven solutions often require a considerable amount of human intervention and lack universal applicability. In our research, we present two innovative neural-based approaches aimed at transforming the chart data extraction field: 1) We have improved the current bottom-up bounding box detection approach for chart components by incorporating multiple transformer-based grouping modules, eliminating the requirement for heuristic rules. 2) Furthermore, we have drawn inspiration from the Question Answering paradigm to develop auto-generated tables. Rather than relying on time-consuming rules that focus on attributes such as position or color, our system identifies more primitive objects (comparable to answers) for each table cell (resembling questions). It is worth mentioning that our work provides impressive accuracy on established benchmarks and is adaptable to new chart designs. Additionally, our method is pioneering in its focus on autonomously learning chart extraction rules, which has the potential to pave the way for more universal chart data extraction in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Scheduling Optimization Algorithm of Logistics Big Data Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time scheduling optimization algorithm based on big data of logistics distribution, aiming to improve the response speed and accuracy of material distribution through the design of intelligent scheduling system. The algorithm model comprehensively considers the dynamic changes of material supply chain, real-time traffic conditions of distribution routes and real-time updates of customer demand. By integrating advanced data analysis technology and machine learning algorithm, the system can monitor the indicators in the logistics distribution process in real time and dynamically adjust the scheduling plan accordingly. In addition, the algorithm also introduces a predictive model to predict potential delivery delays and make scheduling decisions in advance. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, detailed simulation experiments are carried out in this paper. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional scheduling method, the proposed algorithm shows significant advantages in reducing delivery time, reducing transportation cost and improving customer satisfaction. Especially in peak hours and complex road conditions, the optimization effect of the algorithm is more obvious, which effectively alleviates the pressure of logistics distribution.

articleTitle: A Rotary Kiln Temperature Detection System Based on a One-Dimensional Heat Transfer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As indispensable core equipment in metallurgy sec-tors, the operating status of rotary kilns directly impacts prod-uct quality, energy consumption, production safety, and other aspects. However, traditional temperature monitoring methods often rely on manual close-range inspections, which are not only inefficient but also pose significant safety risks. To address this challenge, the paper proposes a rotary kiln temperature detection system based on a one-dimensional heat transfer model. The system aims to achieve remote, real-time, precisely monitoring and prediction of rotary kiln temperature parameters by integrating advanced infrared thermal imaging technology with intelligent algorithms. This innovative solution can not only replaced traditional manual inspection methods, enhancing production safety and effectively, but also optimized it efficiency and reduce energy consumption through real-time data analysis and prediction, thereby achieving efficient resource utilization. Furthermore, the application of this system contributes to advancing traditional metallurgy and other industrial sectors towards a more high-end, intelligent, and green direction, making a significant contribution to the overall transformation and upgrading of China's manufacturing industries.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Control Method of Unmanned Vehicle based on TEB Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the obstacle avoidance problem of unnavigable road sections in an off-road environment, this paper adopts TEB algorithm for obstacle avoidance control. We need to establish hard and soft constraints. Hard constraints are the constraints that must be satisfied, such as steering angle and anti-sideslip. On the basis of the hard constraints, the soft constraints refer to the constraints of the actual scene indicators to obtain the optimal solution of the control points. Then the penalty function is introduced and the death penalty function is used to eliminate all paths that do not meet the requirements of hard constraints. The out-of-point penalty function is established in the path cluster that meets the requirement, and the equation is constructed through the soft constraint requirement, and the path with the least penalty is selected. Finally, the optimal path selected under various constraints is optimized by the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g$</tex>2o algorithm to meet the kinematic and dynamic requirements of the robot and realize obstacle avoidance planning. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an unmanned vehicle test platform.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Recognition Method for Robot Soccer Visual Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Robot soccer, as an advanced field integrating artificial intelligence, image processing, and robot control, has captured the attention of numerous scholars. This study focuses on a rapid recognition method based on omnidirectional vision imagery, aiming to enhance the efficiency of soccer robots in target identification and localization. Initially, the paper explores the selection of omnidirectional vision types and their imaging influencing factors, particularly highlighting the application of catadioptric omnidirectional vision. Subsequently, it analyzes the imaging requirements for spherical targets and proposes a radial length projection model based on convex reflective surfaces. To address issues related to solving reflective surface and viewpoint change errors, this paper establishes corresponding projection functions. Furthermore, it designs a contour-based rapid region labeling algorithm and integrates convex hull restoration methods to improve the accuracy and speed of target recognition. Comparative experiments validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed methods. This research not only provides novel insights into visual image processing for robot soccer but also establishes a foundation for further exploration in related fields.

articleTitle: Analysis of Commercial Cryptography Application and Verification in Intelligent Connected Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The purpose of this project is to solve the information security problems existing in the information of commercial vehicles. The fusion of SM2 packet encryption and SM3 encryption is used to realize the confidential transmission of vehicle information. Virtual security gateway is constructed by CANoe method. The SM2 algorithm is used to encrypt the new value of the message and the initial data area of the message to reduce the risk of plaintext attack. The SM3 method is used to ensure the source validity. The VN1610 car is taken as an example to carry out the field experiment, and the high load performance of CAN bus is verified. The experiment proves that the security communication protocol constructed by SM2 and SM3 encryption methods can reach the data transmission rate of the gateway in terms of computing time. The calculation processes of power-up initialization, public key pair generation, key export, SM2 encryption and encryption of TBOX and PEPS are obtained based on SaleaeLogic8 software. It is found that the high time of SM2 encryption and encryption is mainly due to the complexity of SM2 algorithm itself and the excessive computing overhead of MIARCL.

articleTitle: The Impact of Sample Size after Sampling on the Accuracy of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Sampling techniques are a commonly used method in the field of statistics and machine learning for selecting a portion of a sample from a totality for analysis. The main purpose of sampling techniques in this paper is to deal with imbalanced data in the classification models. In machine learning when the target variable, i.e., positive and negative samples are unbalanced, direct modeling will result in poor model learning ability on a few classes of samples, so sampling is usually required. Based on this research status of existing tools for machine learning such as under-sampling, over-sampling, mixed sampling, etc., this paper will study from three perspectives. First, the effect of different sample sizes through sampling on the model accuracy of the following modeling is explored, and it is found that increasing the sample size may improve the prediction effect of the model. Second, by changing the proportion of positive and negative samples to investigate the changes on the correctness of the model, and found that different positive and negative sample proportions will have an impact on the prediction effect of the model, increasing the proportion of positive samples may improve the accuracy of the model, and balancing the proportion of positive and negative samples may be more conducive to the performance of the model. Thirdly, by exploring the effects of different random seeds values on the model, it is concluded that different random number seeds can make impacts on the stability and generalization ability of the model. The research on this topic can effectively fill the gap in the field of machine learning sampling, and provide some inspirations for determining sample size after sampling as well as the proportion of positive and negative samples.

articleTitle: Overview and Prospect of Spiking Neural Networks Training Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Spiking Neural Network (SNN) is a new generation of neural network model with brain-like bionic structure and event-based driving mechanism, which is characterized by high efficiency and low power consumption. Currently, the main reason limiting the application of SNN in intelligent perception field is the lack of appropriate training algorithm, which cannot effectively utilize the temporal information of spiking neurons. Focused on SNN model, this paper introduces the development process of SNN, analyzes various training algorithm from unsupervised to supervised, and proposes the issue of optimizing training algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Price Prediction Model Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of society, electricity price fluctuation is strong, and many statistical methods are not able to achieve accurate prediction. In order to solve this problem, this paper introduces an artificial intelligence algorithm to optimize the original electricity price prediction method, and predicts the electricity price of two regions in Australia, and compares the conclusions, and optimizes the relevant parameters of the BP neural network and the support vector regression model by using the genetic algorithm and the artificial fish swarm algorithm, respectively. And we compares them to conclude that the electricity price prediction model optimized by the artificial intelligence algorithm achieved more accurate prediction results.

articleTitle: Optimizing Job Matching Efficiency: A Novel Employment Information System Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Optimizing the element of job matching and its efficiency remains fundamental in the labor market. To this effect, a novel employment data information system algorithm remains a widely used approach in optimizing the process, through the leveraging of machine learning models and advanced data analytics. The use of such an algorithm focuses on a set of factors that include precise process of matching, continuous learning, and dynamic adaptability. The algorithm primarily relies on natural language processing (NLP) in understanding resumes and job descriptions beyond the mere use of keyword matching. The process widely takes consideration of semantic and context in ensuring that accurate fits are determined. In the evaluation of experiences, qualifications, and skills, a matched candidate to different roles is determined through the system. This therefore justifies the systems efficiency in dynamically adapting and ensuring that responsive measures are provided to the changing dynamics within the job market. Algorithms are established to provide regular updates continuously through a parameter that relies on real-time data examining the job market. The nature of such adaptability provides an up-to date and timely recommendations to job seekers and employers. This article therefore seeks to conduct an examination on the optimizing of job matching efficiency through a novel employment of information system algorithms. According to findings, information system algorithms play a critical role in refining predictive over time, a process that improves the accuracy of the job matching process and its reliability.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Graduate Employment Rate Based on Chaotic Analysis and Least Squares Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Graduate employment rate is one of the main indicators to measure the quality of college graduates, and its model and forecast play an important role in college employment. In view of the fact that the employment rate of college graduates is restricted by many factors, which leads to the relatively random and chaotic characteristics of employment, this project intends to use the method combining chaos theory and LS-SVM to predict the employment of college students. The chaotic analysis theory is introduced to reconstruct the historical data of graduate employment rate in phase space, and then the historical data of graduate employment rate after phase space reconstruction is used to train the least square support vector machine, and the graduate employment rate prediction model is established according to the optimal parameters. Finally, the simulation and comparative analysis are carried out with the current classical graduate employment rate prediction model. It is found that the prediction accuracy of this model is more than 93<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and a better prediction result of graduate employment rate is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on virtual simulation system of beef cattle segmentation based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper introduces the method of using virtual simulation technology and Unity3D engine to design virtual simulation system of beef cattle segmentation. Through 3dmax modeling and an interactive interface, students can learn the anatomy and muscle tissue of beef cattle in a virtual environment, reducing operational costs and risks, and providing more practice opportunities and feedback. The system design includes scene construction, animation, muscle tissue modeling and other functions, and enhances user experience through button interaction and multi-device support, providing a new teaching method for the education industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Cloud Computing Technology in College Physical Education Classroom Resource Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focuses on the innovative application of cloud computing technology in resource management of college physical education classrooms, aiming to improve the efficiency and fairness of resource allocation through advanced algorithm models. The study uses the tabu search algorithm as the core optimization tool to build a dynamic resource management platform that can respond to changes in demand in physical education classes in real time and intelligently adjust resource allocation strategies. The research first established a resource management framework based on cloud computing, which integrates resource monitoring, data analysis and decision support functions. Subsequently, through the tabu search algorithm, a resource allocation model was designed, which can find optimal or near-optimal resource allocation solutions while considering multiple constraints. In order to verify the effectiveness of the model, the study conducted detailed system simulation, simulated the resource allocation process under different scenarios, and compared the resource utilization and satisfaction indicators before and after model optimization. The simulation results show that the resource management platform using the tabu search algorithm shows higher flexibility and accuracy in resource allocation, and significantly improves the overall utilization efficiency of resources. In addition, the platform can also effectively respond to emergencies, such as temporary course adjustments or equipment failures, ensuring the continuity and stability of physical education activities. This study provides an innovative solution based on cloud computing and intelligent algorithms for college physical education classroom resource management, which has important theoretical and practical significance for promoting the modernization of educational resource management.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Medical & IT Sectors in A-shares Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This research is set against the backdrop of China's Shanghai Stock Exchange A-share market, selecting three representative stocks from each of two distinct sectors as the research objects. Leveraging the “orange” software, we employed the Random Forest model to predict the closing prices of stocks belonging to these two sectors. The findings indicate that, with respect to these two diverse sectors, the Random Forest model yielded no discernible difference in prediction outcomes.

articleTitle: Unveiling Software Vulnerabilities: A Groundbreaking Approach to Defect Detection Utilizing CC2Vec
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to explore the effectiveness of using an improved CC2Vec model for automatically identifying code defects during the software development process. Through in-depth analysis of a large amount of code change data, we demonstrate how the enhanced CC2Vec model accurately extracts key features from complex code change logs, models the hierarchical structure of code changes, and effectively predicts potential software defects. Experimental results show that, compared to traditional rule-based and other machine learning methods, our improved approach significantly enhances key performance indicators such as accuracy, recall, and F1 score, thereby proving the potential application of CC2Vec in the field of defect identification for C++ and Python software.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Algorithms for Optimization of Cross-Country Vehicle Configuration Comparison using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to optimize adaptive algorithms for cross-country vehicle configuration comparison by using deep learning techniques, especially multi-column Deep Convolutional network (MDCNN) vehicle recognition models. The algorithm can automatically identify and compare vehicle configuration differences in different countries and provide consumers with accurate vehicle information. Firstly, a database of automobile images containing various brands and models is constructed, and MDCNN model is used to extract and recognize the features of the images. Through extensive training and verification, the model is able to accurately identify the vehicle model and its configuration differences in different countries. The research further developed an adaptive algorithm, which can automatically select the vehicle with specific configuration according to the needs of users, and carry out cross-country configuration comparison. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed MDCNN model is as high as 95%, which is far superior to the traditional license plate recognition and vehicle classification methods. Adaptive algorithms show a high degree of flexibility and accuracy when dealing with complex cross-country configuration comparisons, which can effectively help users make purchase decisions, and also provide market positioning insights for automobile manufacturers.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning and Improved Algorithms to Optimize E-Commerce Pricing Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: E-commerce pricing models are key consideration for making purchases on the internet. Dynamic e-commerce pricing models, often used by online companies to boost sales and profitability, can greatly benefit them within the consumer market. This study aims to develop machine learning and improved algorithms that will help e-commerce platforms offer the right pricing models to customers. It focuses on companies with inventory leads but could also be useful for stockless online marketplaces. By using statistical and machine learning techniques, the study seeks to understand customer preferences in dynamic or adaptive product pricing based on various data sources such as visit characteristics, visitor traits, purchase history, site data, and context understanding. The article further provides a detailed explanation of how machine learning and improved algorithm may be used in optimizing e-commerce pricing models and revenue optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Aging Furniture System Enabled by Information Interaction and Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focuses on the application of information interaction and communication technology in intelligent furniture system, aiming to develop intelligent furniture solutions. Advanced deep learning techniques, especially the combination of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and recurrent neural networks (RNN), are used in this study to extract efficient features from furniture images in indoor environments. Through this method, the multi-label automatic labeling of furniture can be realized, and the key attribute information such as the type, location, color and material of furniture can be accurately identified. The research results show that the proposed method performs well in improving the accuracy and efficiency of furniture identification, and provides strong technical support for the design and implementation of intelligent aging furniture system. In addition, the system can also realize intelligent interaction between furniture and users through information interaction technology, such as the function of controlling furniture by voice or gesture, which greatly improves the living comfort and convenience of the elderly.

articleTitle: Laboratory information management system and its communication with electronic balance case study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The structure and function of the existing laboratory information management system are introduced, and the program design and parameter setting in the process of data communication between Shimadzu electronic balance (UW4200H) and laboratory data management system are introduced. The sample data is automatically collected to the laboratory information management system through the two-way transmission function of RS232 data protocol. This paper effectively avoids the error in the process of human input, greatly improving the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Recording System of Bogie Maintenance in Subway Frame Overhaul Workshop
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study focused on the bogie repair operation in subway frame overhaul workshop, and constructed a digital recording system integrating 3ds Max virtual assembly, weld fatigue strength evaluation algorithm, data filtering and system simulation. The system realizes the virtual bogie assembly through 3ds Max software, visually displays the structure and assembly process of the bogie, and improves the preparation efficiency before maintenance. The weld fatigue strength evaluation algorithm combined with multi-criterion factors can accurately evaluate the weld of the key parts of the bogie, which provides a scientific basis for the maintenance decision. The data filtering module effectively removes irrelevant information to ensure the purity and reliability of maintenance records.
