The application of system simulation technology, through the simulation of the whole process of bogie maintenance, verifies the effectiveness of the weld fatigue strength evaluation algorithm, and provides detailed simulation results to support accurate data analysis. The in-depth analysis of the simulation results reveals the potential problems and optimization space in the bogie maintenance operation, which provides strong support for improving the maintenance quality and efficiency. Through the design and practice of digital recording system, this study promotes the modernization of subway bogie maintenance technology and provides important support for the intelligent upgrade of subway maintenance management.

Author Keywords: evaluation algorithm of weld fatigue strength

articleTitle: Research on Mining Different Brand Customer Models Based on Correlation Coefficient and Bayesian Discrimination Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To identify potential customers for various car brands, this paper proposes a comprehensive method based on correlation coefficient and Bayes discriminant to solve related problems. First, this research uses random forests treatment groups 1 and 2 outliers, based on more than 1000 copies of survey data as the training base for the model; Secondly, the significant analysis is applied for calculating the significant factors for different brands; Next, we need to use the Bayesian model to train the constant term and coefficient vectors. Finally, we need to use the test set data to test the model. The results show that the prediction accuracy for different brands is above 90%.

articleTitle: Recognition and Analysis of Glass Subsurface Defects by Integrating Machine Vision and Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Machine vision and computer image processing technologies are widely used in the metallurgical industry, especially in recognizing and analyzing defects in glass. High surfaces of planer surface and quality in the glass and metal manufacturing sector primarily require automated and performance visual detection, and inspection systems and algorithms are constantly improving. This article, therefore, seeks to comprehensively recognize and analyze glass subsurface defects through the integration of image processing technologies and machine vision. According to the algorithm's properties and the image features typified in the process, the defects of identified glass components are primarily classified based on determining the cause and the optical features of characteristics exhibited. Given the nature of varied and detected effects determined mainly by the classifiers, an improved accuracy level was notable, and a reduction of the computational complexity was evident following the use of machine vision and image processing technologies.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Analysis of Plantar Pressure Data Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The study focuses on the preprocessing, feature extraction, and in-depth analysis of plantar pressure data. The data is preprocessed through cleaning, signal filtering, noise reduction, and time series correction and synchronization. Subsequently, global, local, and dynamic features are extracted to better analyze the distribution of plantar pressure. Finally, leveraging machine learning techniques, the study delves into the deep exploration of plantar pressure data. Local pressure distribution features and dynamic variation features are extracted using methods such as wavelet transformation for time series analysis. This study also incorporates principal component analysis (PCA) for feature dimensionality reduction and constructs a random forest classifier model. The simulation results demonstrate the model's high accuracy, reaching 95.67%, in distinguishing between healthy individuals and specific disease patients, showcasing its strong diagnostic and health assessment capabilities.

articleTitle: Research on Text Error Correction Algorithm Design in English Writing Aid System for Non-Native Speakers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the design of text error correction algorithm in the English writing aid system for nonnative speakers based on neural network algorithm, aiming at improving the English writing level and text quality of nonnative speakers. First, this paper analyzes the common types of mistakes made by non-native speakers in English writing, including vocabulary, grammar, spelling and punctuation errors. Based on these error types, this paper designs a text error correction algorithm based on neural network, which combines deep learning technology and natural language processing method. The algorithm uses models such as convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network to detect and correct text errors at multiple levels. Through the training of a large number of labeled data, the model can effectively capture the complex structure and semantic relations in the language, and achieve high-precision error recognition and correction. This paper uses a large corpus of English learners to carry out experiments, and the results show that the algorithm based on neural network is significantly better than the traditional rule-based and statistical methods in terms of error recognition and correction accuracy and recall rate.

articleTitle: A Systematic Study of Overseas STEM Education Quality Improvement Curriculum Practice Based on Data Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore a data-driven overseas STEM education quality improvement curriculum practice system. By integrating education quality monitoring and evaluation mechanism, the system uses big data mining platform system and innovative education data cross-source scheduling algorithm to achieve accurate analysis and optimization of STEM education process. Firstly, this paper proposes a new education data cross-source scheduling algorithm, which can effectively extract, integrate and analyze education-related data from multiple data sources, and provide strong data support for the quality assessment of STEM education. Secondly, through the in-depth study of the big data mining platform system, this paper designs a complete algorithm framework for identifying the key factors in the education process, and verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm through model simulation. Finally, this paper shows the application effect of the system in improving the quality of overseas STEM education. The research results show that the proposed data-driven curriculum practice system can significantly improve the teaching efficiency and learning outcomes of STEM education, and provide new ideas and methods for improving the quality of overseas STEM education.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Multimodal Fusion Technology in English Listening and Speaking Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application of multimodal integration technology in English listening and speaking teaching, especially by constructing an innovative English distance teaching system to improve learners' listening and speaking ability. This paper adopts advanced multi-modal feature extraction technologies such as speech recognition, facial expression analysis and eye tracking, combined with deep learning and machine learning algorithms, to achieve accurate capture of learners' verbal output and non-verbal feedback. In the design of the system, this paper pays special attention to the application of hybrid integration strategy, that is, the effective integration of different modal information, in order to provide a richer and more personalized learning experience. Through real-time interaction and feedback mechanisms, the system is able to dynamically adjust teaching content and difficulty to suit the needs of different learners. The experimental results show that the system has achieved remarkable results in improving learners' oral fluency, vocabulary mastery and listening comprehension. The results of this study not only provide a new technical path for English distance teaching, but also provide empirical support for the application of multimodal learning theory.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Distributed Data Mining Method Based on Decision Tree Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The mining of heterogeneous distributed data is a key technology for insight data traceability and classification feature analysis. A heterogeneous distributed data mining method based on decision tree classification algorithm is proposed, and a structured heterogeneous distributed big data label classification model is constructed. The decision tree shift of heterogeneous distributed data is achieved by combining the label classification statistical method. The decision tree classification algorithm is used to achieve label classification statistics and state transfer of distributed big data. Based on the purity deviation difference and direction deviation, the segmentation values in data label classification are reconstructed and the decision tree structure layer is reorganized. The arithmetic difference of each segmentation block of distributed heterogeneous big data is solved, and more embedding capacity is obtained through histogram shift algorithm. The statistical related parameter feature quantity of data is extracted, and screening is carried out according to feature attributes, using mutual information to implement decision tree classification and big data mining for the feature attributes to be embedded. And simulation tests were conducted on the data mining model under different attack models. The simulation results showed that using this method for heterogeneous distributed data mining can design corresponding shift directions and distances for each heterogeneous data distribution area. There will be no errors in the mining process, which improves the traceability and anti attack ability of the data. Moreover, the distortion of the data is small, and the traceability and classification ability of the data are strong.

articleTitle: Design of Brand Positioning and Market Analysis System Based on Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the intensification of market competition and the increasing diversity of consumer demands, scientific brand positioning and visual image design are becoming increasingly important for enterprises' brand marketing strategies. This study aims to construct a brand positioning and marketing system integrating visual design, market analysis, and decision support based on visual communication theory and big data analysis technology. The system, implemented through a distributed microservices architecture, realizes advantages such as high performance and scalability. The visual design module utilizes deep learning technology to automatically generate personalized visual identification schemes, while the data analysis module integrates multiple data sources for mining and analysis. The decision engine integrates the outputs of both modules to form comprehensive brand visual images and marketing strategy recommendations. The system has been validated through multiple practical application cases, significantly enhancing enterprises' brand image and marketing performance. In the future, the system will continue to be optimized and upgraded, exploring new models of integration between visual and data analysis to bring innovative practices to the field of brand marketing.

articleTitle: Optimization of Management Decision Based on Machine Learning: Application of Intelligent Algorithms in Enterprise Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The optimization of an organization's management decisions through the inclusion of machine learning remains a factor that represents significant advancements in the element of enterprise management. These algorithms are designed to focus on the leveraging of intelligent algorithms intended at enhancing the decision-making process. An initial data collection process that involves the collection and the pre-processing of real-time and historical data from different enterprise systems plays a critical role in ensuring the system operates on quality data. Further, a feature selection model is used in the system in identifying varied variables that influence managerial decisions, a process that relies on techniques that include principal component and correlation analysis. A training and validation process equally help in the design of the system as it splits data into validation and training sets through a cross-validation approach that prevents the overfitting while ensuring robust system performance. Lastly, the deployment and optimization of the system helps in refining the model and systems parameters through the use of Bayesian optimization, grid search, and the integration of optimized models into real-time support in the enterprise management system. According to the findings of the study, a continuous improvement of the system is achieved through the monitoring of the model's performance and its periodical retention of new data in a bid to maintain the systems accuracy. The algorithms model facilitates the making of informed and data-driven managerial decisions, thus enhancing the effectiveness and efficiency of enterprise operations.

articleTitle: Resource Optimization and Energy Consumption Management Strategy of 5G Communication Network Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This work aims to achieve dynamic allocation of network resources and precise energy consumption maduces the Power Allocation Algorithm-Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (PAA-DDPG) algorithm, which integrates the advantages of the DDPG algorithm. It addresses the continuity and stochastic characteristics of multi-cell wireless Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) cellular networks, achieving intelligent power allocation through deep reinforcement learning technology. Simulation results demonstrate that the loss values of the PAA-DDPG algorithm rapidly decrease in the early stages of training and consistently remain lower than those of the Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm throughout the training process. In the NOMA environment, the PAA-DDPG algorithm exhibits significantly higher efficiency, achieving an average total rate of 4.67bps. This work realizes dynamic optimization of 5G communication network resources and effective energy consumption management, addressing challenges posed by high-density connections and large-scale device access.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Rendering and Interaction of 3D Objects in Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the real-time rendering and interaction of 3D objects in augmented reality (AR) environment are studied, and a novel lighting model and scene management framework are proposed. Firstly, a mathematical model of the relationship between the surface irradiance and the real light source is established by analyzing the irradiance variation of the location mark surface in the video. The model can iteratively calculate the intensity and direction of the light source in the scene in real time during the interaction process, so as to achieve accurate simulation of the lighting effect of three-dimensional objects. In this paper, the illumination model is integrated into an efficient augmented reality application development framework based on scene management. The framework not only supports fast rendering of 3D objects, but also handles complex interaction logic. In this paper, a smooth position transformation mapping algorithm between 2D and 3D coordinates is proposed to ensure smooth and correct user interaction experience in AR environment. Experimental results show that the proposed technique can significantly improve the rendering speed and interactive responsiveness of 3D objects in augmented reality, while maintaining a high level of visual effects.

articleTitle: Advanced Financial Fraud Detection Using GNN-CL Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The innovative GNN-CL model proposed in this paper marks a breakthrough in the field of financial fraud detection by synergistically combining the advantages of graph neural networks (GNN), convolutional neural networks (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks. This convergence enables multifaceted analysis of complex transaction patterns, improving detection accuracy and resilience against complex fraudulent activities. A key novelty of this paper is the use of multilayer perceptrons (MLPS) to estimate node similarity, effectively filtering out neighborhood noise that can lead to false positives. This intelligent purification mechanism ensures that only the most relevant information is considered, thereby improving the model's understanding of the network structure. Feature weakening often plagues graph-based models due to the dilution of key signals. In order to further address the challenge of feature weakening, GNN-CL adopts reinforcement learning strategies. By dynamically adjusting the weights assigned to central nodes, it reinforces the importance of these influential entities to retain important clues of fraud even in less informative data. Experimental evaluations on Yelp datasets show that the results highlight the superior performance of GNN-CL compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Automobile User Association Recommendation Algorithm Based on Feature Attribute and Matrix Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of association between automobile users and automobile configuration feature attributes under sparse matrix of big data, this paper proposes a matrix decomposition association recommendation algorithm based on automobile users and automobile configuration. Firstly, the crawler technology is used to obtain the data of related automobile websites. Secondly, the vehicle user-vehicle feature attribute system is built, and the crawler data is input into the system to form a sparse matrix. Then, gradient descent algorithm is used to decompose the sparse matrix into two low-dimensional matrices, P and Q. Finally, the prediction matrix is used to recommend the car configuration with large factor to the car users. This method makes up for the research on the association recommendation algorithm between automobile users and automobile product configuration under the background of sparse crawler big data matrix, and provides a reliable theoretical basis for the development of the industry.

articleTitle: Unsteady Roll Gap Prediction Model for Cold Tandem Rolling Based on Hybrid Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Thickness accuracy is a key indicator to measure the quality of cold rolled steel strip, in which the roll gap is a fundamental factor affecting the thickness. In order to improve the thickness control accuracy in the non-steady state process of cold rolling, this paper proposes a new hybrid model for predicting the non-steady state roll gap of cold rolling based on VMD-IGWO-CNN_BiLSTM-RF-XGBoost algorithm. The model follows the principle of decomposition-prediction-reconstruction, utilizes VMD for modal decomposition, and predicts each mode through CNN_BiLSTM-RF and XGBoost models optimized by IGWO. The prediction results are synthesized through wavelet reconstruction, and the weight is assigned using entropy weight method to improve the prediction accuracy. Experiments were performed on a 1450mm cold rolling production line. Through preprocessing data, using MSE, MAE, RMSE, MSLE and R2 evaluation indicators, the prediction ability and generalization performance of the model were confirmed. The results demonstrate that the model can effectively reduce the workload of automatic control system and improve the thickness control accuracy of steel strip.

articleTitle: A systematic study on the application of computer multimodal discourse analysis in English educational assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper explores the innovative application of computer multimodal discourse analysis technology in English education assessment, aiming to provide a scientific basis and technical support for accurate evaluation of English teaching effectiveness. Multimodal discourse analysis integrates text, speech, image, and other channels, which is still in its exploratory phase in educational evaluation. The study reviews multimodal learning theory and computer-assisted language learning (CALL), highlighting potential and challenges. It introduces a multimodal analysis system framework incorporating natural language processing (NLP), speech recognition (ASR), sentiment analysis, and computer vision. This system comprehensively captures language expression, pronunciation accuracy, and non-verbal behavior (like facial expressions), enabling holistic assessment of learners' language abilities. Case studies validate the system's effectiveness, particularly in identifying learning gaps and emotional responses. Ethical considerations, including data privacy and cross-cultural adaptability, are discussed, emphasizing the need for ethical principles and technical standards in multimodal evaluation. In conclusion, multimodal discourse analysis enriches English education assessment, offering insights that deepen understanding of learning processes, inform teaching strategies, and support personalized learning development. Future research should focus on optimizing algorithms, enhancing system intelligence, and exploring broader application scenarios to advance English education assessment modernization.

articleTitle: Algorithm-Driven Brand Design Strategy and Implementation Path Research
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper systematically expounds the implementation path and case application of algorithm-driven brand design. Firstly, it introduces the process of establishing a multi-channel data collection mechanism to obtain massive user behavior data and preprocess it to form a high-quality dataset. Secondly, it illustrates the key technologies for designing generation and optimization based on preprocessed data, such as dual-path convolutional neural networks, generative adversarial networks, etc. Furthermore, it elaborates on the method of integrating algorithms with existing design processes to achieve human-machine collaboration and enhance decision-making efficiency. Finally, it discusses the importance of continuously optimizing algorithm models through “online learning” mechanisms to ensure their up-to-dateness. The paper inserts multiple real cases and supplements them with chart data, comprehensively demonstrating the innovative applications of algorithm-driven brand design in multiple fields. Overall, algorithms are reshaping a new paradigm of brand design, providing unprecedented personalized experiences for consumers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Command Efficiency for UAV Defense Swarm Based on Informationized Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The construction of command systems for defending against UAV swarms in the current informationized environment has opened new possibilities while presenting significant challenges. Investigating the command efficiency in the UAV defense swarms is very crucial for improving the command processes and enhancing overall system efficiency. The analysis of factors influencing the command efficiency of UAV defense group is the basis of improving command flow and enhancing combat effectiveness. This paper focuses on exploring command processes from the perspectives of information, systems, and institutions, then establishes a collection of factors influencing the command efficiency of defending against UAV swarms and proposes four strategic recommendations.

articleTitle: Mixed Integer Programming Algorithm in the Optimization of Air Traffic Control Flight Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the global aviation industry, the sharp increase in the number of flights has put forward higher requirements for air traffic management, especially in ensuring flight punctuality and aviation safety. This study focuses on flight scheduling problems in air traffic control, using the Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) algorithm to optimize scheduling strategies. Specifically, the article constructed a mathematical model that includes multiple constraints such as airport capacity, flight time windows, and flight connectivity, and iteratively solved the problem to find the optimal or approximately optimal scheduling solution. This method not only improves the efficiency of scheduling, but also enhances the flexibility and practicality of scheduling schemes, providing an effective tool for aviation control departments to reduce flight delays, improve airspace utilization efficiency, and passenger satisfaction. In sunny and cloudy weather, the accuracy of the algorithm can reach 97% or above, indicating that the algorithm can accurately schedule flights under normal conditions. The research results of this article can provide theoretical basis and technical support for the modernization of China's aviation control construction. The research results of this article can to some extent enrich the basic theory of flight scheduling and provide new ideas and methods for solving practical problems.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Impact of Ambient Lighting on Immersion in Virtual Environments across Different Game Genres through Scales, Eye-Tracking and EEG
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study will explore how ambient lighting affects user immersion in virtual environments (VEs), and whether this influence varies across different game genres. Additionally, to enhance the accuracy of our results, we will further investigate the mechanisms through which ambient lighting affects user immersion across different games in virtual environments. This deeper exploration is intended to provide more comprehensive understandings of interaction between independent variables (ambient lighting and game genres) and the dependent variable (user immersion). By integrating quantitative scales, qualitative interviews, eye-tracking technology, and EEG data, the research provides a comprehensive understanding of how different lighting conditions influence immersion. The integration of eye-tracking technology and EEG can provide a deeper insight into user engagement and brain activity. Eye-tracking data offers precise measurements of gaze patterns, highlighting where users were looking and how they reacted to different lighting conditions. EEG data, on the other hand, allows for real-time monitoring of brain activity and offers a physiological perspective on immersion. The analysis of Alpha and Beta bands can provide valuable information on the neural correlates of immersive experiences.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction and Classification Accuracy Improvement System Through Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the realm of computer big data, investigating systems that enhance feature extraction and classification accuracy is crucial for boosting the efficiency of data processing and analysis. This paper discusses feature extraction and classification in big data environment, and proposes a hybrid feature extraction method that combines deep learning and traditional machine learning techniques. Through adaptive data preprocessing, automated feature extraction and selection, and multi-scale feature fusion, this approach notably enhances both the accuracy and representativeness of feature representation. In the classification stage, this paper designs and implements a multi-layer classifier structure, synthesizes the results of multiple basic classifiers by means of ensemble learning strategy, voting, weighted average, etc., so as to improve the reliability and accuracy of classification decision. The experiments were conducted on several publicly available large data sets, and the results show that the proposed method is significantly superior to the prior art in terms of classification accuracy, processing speed and model robustness, demonstrating its potential and advantages in big data analysis. The findings of this study offer novel insights and technical backing for feature extraction and classification in the context of big data environments, presenting broad application prospects and practical value.

articleTitle: Resource Scheduling for Post-earthquake Building Emergency Response with Application of Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rapid evaluation of buildings after earthquake and the rational allocation of emergency resources are the keys to reduce the impact of earthquake disasters and improve the efficiency of rescue. In this study, artificial bee colony algorithm was used to dispatch the emergency rescue resources of buildings after the earthquake. By simulating the damage situation after the earthquake, a multi-objective optimization model was established in combination with the availability of resources and the urgency of demand. Specific methods include using geographic information system (GIS) data to determine the most affected areas, using artificial bee colony algorithm to optimize resource allocation, such as the optimal path and schedule of personnel, equipment and materials. The model was verified by field data, and the effectiveness and practicability of the algorithm were verified. In the case of unlimited resources, the algorithm performed best, achieving high coverage and resource utilization, and the satisfaction rate of key areas was 100%. The research results of this paper greatly improve the real-time and accuracy of emergency rescue resource scheduling, which is of great significance to improve the scientific level and rapid response ability of emergency rescue command. The research results of this paper also provide new methods and means for the emergency management of earthquake disasters in China.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Power Transmission System for Rebar Corrosion Monitoring Based on Electromagnetic Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Reinforced concrete structures are widely used in the construction industry. However, rebar corrosion within these structures remains a critical factor affecting their durability. This paper proposes a novel wireless power transfer (WPT) system for rebar corrosion monitoring based on electromagnetic coupling resonance. This system ingeniously integrates both rebar corrosion detection and WPT functionalities within a single electromagnetic coupling circuit, achieving miniaturization and cost-effectiveness. The proposed system utilizes the principle of LC resonant circuits. An embedded sensor, comprising multiple steel wires of varying thicknesses, is pre-embedded within the reinforced concrete structure. As corrosion leads to the fracture of these wires, the resonant frequency of the circuit changes. By measuring these frequency shifts, the system can accurately reflect the corrosion state of the rebar. Furthermore, a self-oscillating inverter is introduced at the external transmitter side. This not only enables automatic resonant frequency tracking and eliminates the need for frequency sweeping circuits but also facilitates efficient WPT to the embedded sensor, providing long-term, stable power supply to the system. Finally, simulations validate the effectiveness of the proposed system. By leveraging wireless power and sensing capabilities through electromagnetic coupling, the system achieves long-term, non-destructive monitoring of rebar corrosion within concrete structures, demonstrating significant advantages in convenience, reliability, and scalability.

articleTitle: Research on Product Quality Control Algorithm System of Intelligent Manufacturing Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, an improved PRO-PSO algorithm is proposed for intelligent manufacturing industry to achieve efficient performance in product quality control and anomaly location. The effect of the number of neurons on the detection accuracy and the risk of misjudgment, and the significant effect of data characteristics on the performance of the model were verified by experiments. After optimization, the model achieves an anomaly detection accuracy of 88.02%, a false detection rate of 1.13%, and a positioning accuracy of 99.4%. This achievement provides cutting-edge quality control means for intelligent manufacturing industry, significantly improves production efficiency and product quality by accurately identifying and locating abnormal data, and lays a solid foundation for the construction of intelligent manufacturing system in the era of Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: The Spatio-Temporal Stock Prediction Method Based on End-to-End Learning with Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Stock price prediction has always been a topic of interest for financial investors. However, stock data always exhibit issues such as instability, nonlinearity, and abrupt changes, posing significant challenges to stock prediction. To address these issues, this paper proposes a spatial learning model based on end-to-end learning with an attention mechanism (SLMBA) to improve prediction performance. By modeling the spatiotemporal relationships of exogenous variables and the temporal relationships of the target data into a single framework, and then using the attention mechanism to filter different features, precise prediction of stock data is achieved. Experimental results show that the SLMBA model outperforms other models in terms of generalization ability and prediction accuracy, allowing for more accurate stock data predictions and helping investors make rational stock choices.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Prediction in Thermoelectric Coupled Systems Based on Improved Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem of carbon emission prediction under the thermoelectric coupling system, the IEEMD-GRU model was innovatively proposed in this study, which combined with improved ensemble empirical mode decomposition and gated cycle unit technology, significantly improved the prediction accuracy. Compared with the three types of models of traditional methods, IEEMD-GRU performs well in trend prediction and data fitting, especially in robustness and accuracy when dealing with non-abnormal data points. In view of its excellent performance, IEEMD-GRU models are recommended as a priority in carbon intensity prediction to obtain more reliable and refined results to assist environmental policy making and energy strategic planning.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transportation System Management System Based on OneNet and MQTT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This research is aim to develop an urban street lamp monitoring system based on the Internet of Things. Through the in-depth study of the Internet of Things technology and market demand analysis, the functional requirements and performance indicators of the system are determined. In the design process, the modular design idea is used to divide the system into several sub-modules, such as timer processing module, sensor group module, GPS positioning module, WiFi networking module and serial port printing module, and carry out detailed design and implementation. At the same time, in order to improve the stability and reliability of the system, a variety of technical means and various code-assisted debugging statements are used to optimize and improve. Finally, a city street lamp monitoring system with perfect function and stable performance is completed, and its feasibility and practicability are verified by computer experiments. The design of this topic not only improves the intelligent level of urban street lamp monitoring, but also provides a useful reference for the application of Internet of Things technology in the field of urban street lamp service. However, there are still some limitations in this study, and the research scope can be further expanded in the future to optimize the solution.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Intelligent Algorithms in the Automation of Music Generation and Composition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study explores recent advances in intelligent algorithms for the automation of music generation and arrangement, with a particular focus on the potential applications of Markov decision processes (MDP) and Deep Q-Networks (DQN) in this area. We propose an innovative framework for music composition that uses MDPS to construct dynamic environments for music generation, where transition probabilities describe the likelihood of moving from one musical state to another, and reward functions quantify the degree of improvement in music quality. Then DQN uses deep neural network to approximate the Q-value function, so as to effectively learn the optimal action strategy in the high-dimensional music state space. In the process of interaction with the environment, it gradually learns how to choose the most appropriate action at a given music state to maximize the long-term cumulative reward. The framework combining the two can not only significantly improve the intelligence level of music creation. It could also push the music industry in a more personal and innovative direction.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Short Video Recommendation System based on User Behavior Data Mining and Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper investigates the development of an e-commerce short video recommendation system based on user behavior data mining and feature extraction, and the core of our approach is the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNS) in the broader scope of data-driven insights. By harnessing the power of CNN, we aspire to dig deep into the vast library of e-commerce short videos and decipher the visual cues and patterns that define user preferences and product characteristics. Through meticulous model training, we aim to achieve high-fidelity identification of key video frames and then automatically label and classify video content based on user interests and product categories. We then designed a CNN architecture specifically tailored to the nuances of e-commerce video content, optimizing it to recognize not only product features, but also subtle contexts that affect user engagement. Using an extensive data set with user behavior patterns and product metadata annotations, we conducted an exhaustive training regimen that allows the model to proficiently grasp and interpret the various product demonstrations and user interactions depicted in the videos. Initial evaluations show that our proposed framework significantly improves the accuracy of video classification.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence-based Sports Orienteering Movement Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper delves into an AI-based sports-oriented motion recognition system. With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence technology, the demand for precise motion recognition in the field of sports is steadily increasing. The focus of this paper is on exploring action recognition datasets, keyframe extraction methods, image filtering techniques, and research on skeleton key point detection based on OpenPose. Through a detailed analysis of skeleton key point detection methods and models, combined with RGB data for human behavior recognition, an efficient sports-oriented motion recognition system has been designed and implemented. Experimental results demonstrate that the system proposed in this paper exhibits significant advantages in both recognition accuracy and real-time performance, providing new technological support and theoretical basis for future sports motion analysis and intelligent training.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Intelligent Decision Support System in the Optimal Allocation of Higher Education Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on Decision Support System (DSS), this paper integrates Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to construct an intelligent decision support system, and uses the complementary advantages of the two to optimize the resource allocation problem of higher education system. The framework uses the global optimization ability and fast search characteristics of genetic algorithm to iteratively generate and evaluate various configuration schemes of higher education resources. Then based on historical data and candidate schemes generated by GA, SVM accurately predicts the potential impact of each configuration scheme on education effectiveness by constructing a high-dimensional nonlinear decision boundary. It reduces the decision-making errors caused by local optimal solutions, improves the overall benefit of resource allocation, forms a set of closed-loop optimization process, and can automatically adjust the strategy according to the change of educational environment.

articleTitle: Research on Micro Grid Group System in Coastal Area Based on Improved PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the background that the transformation of China's power structure is arduous and urgent, the development of distributed generation undoubtedly provides a practical solution to the problem of power structure. This paper aims to optimize the dispatch of microgrid system by introducing the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, so as to make full use of a variety of distributed generation units and show the advantages of the integrated dispatch of microgrid system. This paper selects the climate data of the Bohai Coastal Area as the research object, and verifies the feasibility of the optimized microgrid system in alleviating the load pressure in the coastal area through the simulation analysis of a numerical example, which significantly reduces the power load pressure in the Bohai Coastal Area, and provides valuable reference value and practical experience for the construction and development of the microgrid in the coastal area.

articleTitle: Research on the Cloud and Network Integration Native Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Nowadays, new emerging services are facing many challenges in terms of capacity supply, such as the inability to share capabilities among platforms, the unsmooth activation of cloud and network resources, and the slow deployment of applications. To meet the scale development needs of the new emerging services, a cloud and network integration native solution is proposed, aiming to achieve rapid integrated supply of cloud, computing and network resources, rapid deployment by Software as a Service (SaaS), and intelligent operation. This paper firstly proposes cloud and network integration native concept, introduces the cloud and network native integration service scenarios and key technologies, presents an integrated solution of resources scheduling and service deployment for SaaS applications, and finally verifies the feasibility of the solution through practical cases.

articleTitle: An Analytical Model of a Multi-beam Detection System Based on Basis Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the application of multi-beam sounding system in seabed topographic survey, paying special attention to how to achieve the overlap rate requirement of 10%~20% between adjacent strips while ensuring the comprehensive coverage of the sea area to be measured. To this end, this paper establishes an analytical model of the basis transformation. By introducing two coordinate systems and using the coordinate transformation, the 2D analytic model is successfully constructed, which further solves the coverage width through geometric relations. In the model generalization, the 3D coordinate system and multi-variables setting are used to obtain a set of implicit equations. On this basis, the geometric relation and the interpolation fit are used to replace the submarine surface with the two-plane approximation. When designing the line, the classification discussion and iterative traversal method based on greedy algorithm get the optimal parallel line with north-south direction. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the model are verified by numerical solution test and length calculation, and the line spacing, coordinate position and number of bars meet the requirements, and the bus length is 255 nautical miles. This study provides strong support for the practical application of multi-beam sounding system in seabed topographic survey, and is of great significance for Marine scientific research.

articleTitle: Application and Design Implementation of Deep Learning Algorithms Based on Artificial Intelligence in Virtual Reality Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid advancement of virtual reality (VR) technology has greatly enhanced user interaction experiences. Concurrently, artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning algorithms, have shown powerful potential in areas such as gesture recognition, offering new perspectives and methodologies for VR interaction design. This article begins by introducing the fundamental theory of deep learning, encompassing convolutional neural networks (CNN), nonlinear activation functions, loss functions, and the training process. Subsequently, it delves into the application of deep learning in gesture recognition, conducting a detailed analysis of data collection and preprocessing for datasets, network model design, and optimization strategies. Following this, the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed methods are validated through a series of experiments. Furthermore, the performance of the model at different testing stages is assessed. Ultimately, the advantages and challenges of deep learning-based gesture recognition in virtual reality interaction are summarized, accompanied by an outlook on future developmental directions.

articleTitle: Multi-Beam Line Placement Strategy Based on Single-Objective Programming and Greedy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a significant surge of progress related to the optimization of multi-beam line placement to enhance the accuracy and precision of measurement. This paper presents a method based on a three- dimensional (3D) model and single-objective programming to solve the problem of the optimal placement of multi-beam lines. The ultimate goal of this approach is to ensure efficient and precise measurement. The study constructs a model to realize the calculation of depth, coverage width, and overlap rate. Subsequently, an optimal line placement strategy was derived through the application of single-objective programming and greedy algorithms. The practicality and effectiveness of the strategy are verified by several simulation experiments, and the results show that the strategy can significantly improve the efficiency and quality of mapping. Finally, this study explores the practical application of the strategy and designs optimal multi-beam lines with a total length of 148133.72 m for a certain area. The applicability and superiority of the scheme are verified, providing an innovative technical scheme for modern measurement tasks.

articleTitle: An Empirical Systematic Study of Deep Learning-Based Software Defect Prediction Models in Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the advanced reinforcement learning technology is integrated, and an innovative strategy of teaching resources optimization and students' learning path adaptive adjustment is proposed. By using the instant feedback and strategy update ability of the Actor-Critic algorithm, and the decision-making advantage of DQN in high-dimensional state space, the accurate recommendation of students personalized learning paths and the efficient allocation of teaching resources are realized. In this paper, the strategy network (Actor) is constructed to explore and formulate the learning path strategy, the value network (Critic) is used to evaluate the quality of the strategy, and the rapid strategy iteration is realized. The Q-value function is constructed based on the deep neural network, which is used to select the optimal or near-optimal learning resource allocation scheme among a large number of possible actions, so as to improve students' learning effectiveness and satisfaction. Optimizing the management efficiency of practical courses provided a new perspective and feasible scheme for the future development of smart education.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Cloud Modeling based on the Combination of Meteorological Data and Multiple Noises
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to create a more realistic cloud simulation environment, volumetric cloud modeling combined with real meteorological data is usually considered. At present, cloud simulation based on real meteorological data basically adopts physical modeling methods, such as solving fluid dynamics equations and particle system modeling, etc. However, these methods involve a large amount of calculation for solving calculus equations, so they are often limited in the scale of drawing, and it is difficult to perform real-time simulation in large-scale scenes. The authenticity and real-time performance of volumetric cloud simulation still need to be further improved. Therefore, through the analysis of existing research, a three-dimensional volumetric cloud construction method based on meteorological data is proposed. The specific method is to generate a two-dimensional cloud map based on humidity data, and then combine the cloud map with an improved height density function to make the shape and density of the cloud change with height and meteorological data, and combine it with multiple noises to construct the shape and details of the cloud. Finally, the Raymarching algorithm is used for rendering, and finally a large-scale volumetric cloud that matches the meteorological data is constructed. This paper combines meteorological data with non-physical modeling methods effectively. Experimental results show that the volumetric cloud modeled by this method matches the cloud map generated by meteorological data, and is more realistic in shape and appearance. The cloud body modeling results have more realistic details without distortion.

articleTitle: Design of a Brand Emotional Connection System Based on Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a visual brand emotional connection system, integrating computer vision, natural language processing, and affective computing technologies to achieve precise recognition of brand visual elements, analysis of user emotional states, and generation of personalized emotional expressions. The system adopts a modular design, demonstrating outstanding accuracy in visual recognition, emotional connection effects, and user experience levels. After comprehensive testing and evaluation, an optimization plan is formulated to further enhance capabilities such as font recognition, emotional sentence generation, interface loading, and personalized recommendations, continuously optimizing the user experience. This system is expected to become an outstanding representative in the fields of visual brand marketing and emotional connection, promoting emotional bonds between brands and users and continuously increasing brand influence.

articleTitle: Prediction of Hematoma Expansion in Hemorrhagic Stroke Based on PSO-MNN and GRNN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the prediction of hematoma expansion in hemorrhagic stroke patients was studied. The PSO-MNN model was constructed by using wavelet neural network (WNN) combined with particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to improve the prediction accuracy. Firstly, based on the complexity of the problem and the characteristics of the data set, the WNN network structure including input layer, hidden layer and output layer is constructed. Secondly, to optimize the network parameters, the PSO algorithm is used to fine-adjust the weight, threshold and wavelet function parameters in WNN to improve the prediction performance of the model. The performance of WNN is compared with other artificial neural networks, including error backpropagation algorithm (BP neural network) and long and short time memory network (LSTM). Finally, based on the Gauss model, a curve of edema volume progression over time was constructed, and the GRNN neural network model was used to analyze the correlation between treatment and edema progression. The study in this paper effectively improved the prediction accuracy of hematoma expansion, and provided strong technical support for the clinical intelligent diagnosis and treatment of hemorrhagic stroke.

articleTitle: Mechanical Modeling and Design Optimization of Heliostat Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The paper studies the mechanical modelling and optimal design of a heliostat lens farm for a tower photovoltaic plant. In this paper, geometrical optics, coordinate transformation and multi-objective optimisation methods are used to construct the model of the optical efficiency of the heliostat field. Firstly, the change of the sun position is simulated to derive the coordinate transformation equation to calculate the shadow shading between the heliostats. Secondly, the optical efficiency calculation model is established, including mirror reflectivity, cosine loss, attenuation loss, shading and collector truncation efficiency. Finally, the particle swarm optimisation algorithm is used to optimise the mirror arrangement to improve the overall optical efficiency. The research provides an essential theoretical foundation and technical support for the design and operation of tower-type photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: Enhancing Elderly Safety: A Machine Learning-Driven Acoustic System for In-Home Fall Detection and Alerting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rapidly aging global population and the increase in time spent at home by the elderly, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, have highlighted a critical need for innovative healthcare solutions. One of the most pressing concerns in elderly care is the high risk and frequency of falls, which are the leading cause of accidental deaths and severe injuries in this demographic. With current technologies largely relying on visual systems that raise privacy concerns and incur significant costs, there is an urgent need for a more practical and respectful solution. This paper presents a novel machine learning-based approach to detect falls among the elderly using sound as the primary sensory input. We have developed an intelligent terminal that employs sound sensors to collect audio information within home settings, thereby creating a comprehensive database of real elderly fall incidents. By extracting kinematic, temporal, and dynamic features from actual falls and everyday activities, we designed and trained machine learning algorithms to discern fall events with high accuracy. Comparative assessments of the developed algorithms against benchmark classification metrics, such as the Area Under the Curve (AUC), reveal the robustness of our approach, with the best-performing models achieving AUC values exceeding 0.95. The system proposed herein offers a low-cost, privacy-preserving, and low-latency alternative to camera-based fall detection systems, showing great promise for widespread adoption in aging societies and private homes. This research signifies a step forward in facilitating safer independent living conditions for the elderly and reducing the healthcare burden associated with falls.

articleTitle: A Method of Electricity Bill Payment Behavior Pattern Recognition Based on Kernel PCA and Hierarchical Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The identification of the user's electricity payment behavior pattern is of great significance to both the power enterprise and the electric power user. On the one hand, through the recognition of electricity bill payment behavior pattern, the power enterprise can assess the credit status of users and discover the potential risk of non-payment in a timely manner. On the other hand, through the recognition of electricity bill payment behavior pattern, the power enterprise can provide users with personalized electricity advice and personalized service, which can not only achieve energy saving and emission reduction, reduce operating cost and further improve economic benefit, but also enhance the satisfaction and loyalty of the electric power user. In this paper, we propose a method for recognizing electricity bill payment behavior pattern of the electric power user based on hierarchical kernel principal component analysis (PCA) and hierarchical clustering. The method firstly extracts the user's electricity bill payment features and electricity consumption behavior features, and then uses the hierarchical kernel PCA method to downscale the above features to obtain the user's key nonlinear features. Finally, different electricity bill payment behavior patterns of the electric power users are recognized by the hierarchical clustering. The results show the method can realize accurate prediction and classification of users' electricity bill payment behavior patterns.

articleTitle: Application and evaluation system of deep learning in automatic summary generation of English reading materials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the field of artificial intelligence, deep learning has solidified its position as a major technology in the field of computational linguistics. The direction of this academic effort is to investigate the utility of deep learning in automating the creation of abstracts of literary works in English, while developing a critical mechanism for assessing their proficiency. Through careful study and comparative analysis of different deep learning paradigms, including recurrent neural networks (RNNS), Long short-term memory networks (LSTMs), and the cutting-edge Transformer model, we conceived of a streamlined automated profile generator. With the constraints and validation of a large number of English texts, the results show that the Transformer driven model achieves higher accuracy in terms of accuracy, narrative fluidity, and information density contained in the summary.

articleTitle: Vegetable Sales Forecasting Based on XGBOOST Algorithm and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper explores the forecasting of vegetable sales and the optimization of procurement strategies using the XGBOOST algorithm and random forest methodology. The study begins by utilizing a factor analysis model to investigate the comprehensive correlation of vegetable sales among various types. It then employs Spearman correlation analysis to evaluate the specific inter-relationships between different vegetable groups. The examination uncovers notable disparities in the aggregate sales quantities among vegetable categories, with the strongest association found between solanaceous and aquatic root vegetables. Afterward, regression models based on random forest and XGBOOST are constructed to forecast the sales quantities for distinct vegetable categories. The outcomes show that the XGBOOST regression model attains an R-squared value of 0.945, outperforming the random forest regression model, which has a R-squared value of 0.576. In addition, a time series model is created to predict the future wholesale pricing of individual vegetable categories, exhibiting a satisfactory model fit with an R-squared value of 0.619.

articleTitle: Simple Graph Sampling-Based Meta-Learning for Molecular Property Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: We focuses on the challenges and advances in molecular property prediction within the field of drug discovery, particularly when addressing small sample sizes. In seeking to enhance predictive accuracy while reducing costs and time expenditure, novel computational approaches are explored. Notably, the integration of meta-learning and contrastive learning has demonstrated potential, as evidenced in methods. Despite these advancements, persistent issues such as slow model training and sensitivity to data noise undermine practical applicability. Our research introduces a new optimization strategy that incorporates random noise during subgraph sampling in the GS-Meta model to tackle these challenges. The approach significantly increases the robustness and accuracy of molecular property predictions. Our findings, corroborated by robust performance metrics, indicate the promising potential of random noise optimization in molecular property prediction models. Future research should continue to explore these techniques' generalizability across larger datasets and the impact of different noise injection strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Elasticity Modeling and Risk Mitigation Model Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: An elastic modeling and risk mitigation method of supply chain based on big data analysis is proposed. The aim is to quantify the deformation characteristics of supply chain system by mathematical model, analyze its response behavior under the action of risk, and identify the critical state of system collapse. This paper constructs an elastic system model that comprehensively considers the interaction of all links in the supply chain, which can describe the dynamic changes of the supply chain in the process of risk loading and unloading, and predict the sensitivity and resilience of the system to external disturbances. By introducing the risk response function, people quantify the absorption and dispersion ability of the supply chain system to different types of risks, and then evaluate the stability of the system under risk shocks. The study reveals the threshold conditions of supply chain system collapse, and provides an early warning mechanism and decision support for risk managers. In order to verify the validity of the theoretical model, people use MATLAB simulation software to carry out a large number of simulation experiments, and the results show that the model can accurately predict the risk response behavior of the supply chain system, and guide the design of risk mitigation strategy in practice.

articleTitle: Design of a Blockchain-Based Agricultural Product Traceability and Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The tracing data of online products is primarily regulated by a central platform, which introduces a potential risk of data tampering by either the platforms or the merchants, ultimately undermining the trust mechanism between consumers and merchants. Blockchain technology, characterized by its decentralization, tamper-resistance, and anti-counterfeiting features, can effectively address the issue of authenticity in the traceability data of agricultural products. This study proposes a traceability and recommendation system for agricultural products based on the Chainmaker platform, employing Solidity to develop smart contracts and utilizing SDK node.js for data storage of agricultural products on the blockchain. Consequently, reliable product recommendations for customers can be achieved. As a result, the authenticity of product data is enhanced, leading to increased information disclosure and heightened consumer trust.

articleTitle: A Novel Graph Convolutional Neural Network Based on Convolutional Features for Interval Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Accurately predicting interval stock prices is challenging yet crucial for investors and profit-driven organizations. In this research, by simultaneously considering stock prices, technical indicators, and investor sentiment, a novel method based on an interval Triple Convolutional Neural Network (Triple-CNN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sup>) model is proposed to predict interval stock prices. Firstly, MIC is used to screen the technical indicator variables, then the data is coordinate-transformed and converted into images. Finally, the Triple-CNN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sup> model is designed to forecast interval stock prices. In particular, three different CNN models are constructed to extract price features, technical indicator features, and sentiment features, respectively. These features are fed into an interval Multilayer Perceptron (MLP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sup>) model for predicting final interval stock prices. Extensive experiments were carried out on two selected stocks, comparing the proposed approach with several popular machine learning methods and those excluding sentiment features. The experimental results demonstrate that the Triple-CNNI-based method offers superior predictive performance.

articleTitle: Research on Short Video Personalized Recommendation Algorithm based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, in recent years, mobile short video platforms such as Douyin and Kuaishou have shown a strong development trend in China. In order to alleviate and solve the problem of “information overload” of short videos, effective recommendation algorithms must be available to help users find short videos they are interested in. Traditional recommendation algorithms can be basically divided into three categories: collaborative filtering based recommendation algorithm, content-based recommendation algorithm and popularity-based recommendation algorithm. In addition to popularity-based recommendation algorithms, both traditional recommendation algorithms and deep learning recommendation algorithms use the similarities between users or items to “cluster” things and “group” people, so they can achieve personalized recommendation. The traditional recommendation algorithm is simple, the model parameters are small, and the online real-time performance is high, but the expression ability is weak. The deep learning recommendation algorithm has strong expression ability, and can mine more hidden patterns in the data, but the model parameters are large, and occupy more spatial resources such as memory and video memory. Not only is the training time and testing time of offline model much higher than that of traditional recommendation model, but also brings great challenges to the real-time performance of online recommendation system. In this paper, we propose a short video personalized recommendation algorithm based on the improved THACIL model, which has done important work in the attention mechanism of the original THACIL model. Compared with the original THACIL model, the improved algorithm can not only make use of the advantages of deep learning, but also reduce the complexity of the model and greatly reduce the scale of model parameters. When the relevant indicators such as AUC, accuracy rate and recall rate are slightly higher than the original THACI model, it can also significantly reduce the offline training time and test time of the model. We need to improve the real-time performance of online recommendations. The model proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the occupancy rate of time and space resources. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by comparative analysis of relevant indexes between the proposed algorithm and the representative algorithm. Moreover, the model parameters, training time and test time of the improved THACIL algorithm and the original THACIL algorithm are compared, and the results also validate the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Integrated Learning Prediction Study of Diabetes Mellitus Based on Random Forest and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the prediction of diabetes in the elderly was studied deeply. The model was constructed and verified by integrated learning method combined with random forest and support vector machine model. First of all, we use the random forest model for feature selection to identify the factors that have a significant impact on diabetes prediction, such as hypertension, heart disease and self-rated health, etc., which provides a basis for the subsequent model construction. Secondly, we constructed an integrated learning model based on the Stacking strategy. Random forest and support vector machines are used as base learners and are integrated with meta-learners to improve prediction accuracy and stability. In the process of model construction, we optimized the kernel function of SVM and found that the kernel function of Polynomial performs best in diabetes prediction. Finally, the ensemble learning model is verified by experiments, and the results show that the model achieves high accuracy on training set, cross-validation set and test set, showing good prediction performance. This model not only provides a new and effective tool for the prediction of diabetes in the elderly, but also provides a new idea and method for the prediction of other diseases.

articleTitle: A Novel Distance Measure for Interval-Valued Picture Fuzzy Sets Based on Squared Chord Distance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on the definition of squared chord distance for n-dimensional vectors, this research proposes a novel distance measure approach for Interval-Valued Picture Fuzzy Sets (IVPFSs), tailored to enhance uncertainty management in pattern recognition and decision-making. This method integrates membership, non-membership, and hesitation degrees, ensuring robust performance even when traditional metrics falter or yield counterintuitive outcomes. Thoroughly validated against established axiomatic principles, the methodology proves both theoretically sound and practically effective. Empirical testing highlights its superior ability to resolve ambiguities unaddressed by existing methods, marking it as a crucial instrument for boosting accuracy and reliability across diverse applications. Additionally, the applicability of this method extends beyond technical realms to include business and social sciences, areas often dependent on the precise interpretation of ambiguous and incomplete data. Offering a more accurate and intuitive measurement strategy, it assists decision-makers in navigating complex scenarios, enabling informed, data-driven decisions. Future research aims to expand its application to fields like medical diagnosis, risk management, and systems engineering, potentially amplifying its impact and applicative reach.

articleTitle: Social Media User Behavior Prediction and Personalized Digital Marketing Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study aims to explore the deep learning technology. By combining the hybrid model of Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) and Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM), the GBDT model is good at dealing with the nonlinear relationship and high-dimensional features of social media data, and automatically filters out the features most relevant to user behavior, reduces the data dimension, and retains key information. The input selection of the LSTM model was guided to ensure that the model focused on the most relevant behavior patterns. Then the LSTM model was applied to process the time series data of user behavior to capture the dynamic changes and long-term dependence of user behavior. Therefore, a cascade architecture is adopted to generate a concise and informative feature set by using GBDT to preprocess the raw data. These features are then fed into the LSTM model for building a time series prediction model. This architecture generates highly personalized marketing recommendations based on a deep understanding of user behavior so as to improve the marketing effect and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Transportation System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rise of big data technology brings new development opportunities for intelligent transportation systems. This paper introduces the design and implementation of an intelligent transportation system based on big data. The system architecture consists of data layer, computing layer, service layer, and application layer. It integrates heterogeneous traffic data through data fusion module, utilizes machine learning algorithms for traffic flow analysis, road condition prediction, etc., and provides decision support services. In terms of implementation, it elaborates on development environment configuration, key algorithm implementation, and system testing. Finally, taking Beijing as an example, it demonstrates the application cases of using the system for traffic status evaluation, future road condition prediction, and traffic management decision-making. Practice proves that big data-driven intelligent transportation systems help improve urban traffic operation efficiency and are an important part of building smart cities.

articleTitle: Decentralized Information Resource Management: Leveraging Blockchain for Sustainable Development and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The present study offers a comprehensive examination of blockchain technology as a revolutionary instrument to foster progress across multiple industries, such as finance, healthcare, and agriculture. The analysis of data resource management, the decentralized structure of blockchain, and its function in enhancing transaction security and transparency is the goal of the study. The potential of blockchain technology to tackle significant sustainability issues like data exchange integrity, on-chain transmission, and resource management capabilities is examined. Here, we present a novel blockchain model that addresses integration issues by emphasizing security, privacy, and compatibility while demonstrating how blockchain technology can help realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the UN. This architecture is constructed in layers to increase security and anonymity. It incorporates elements of both public and private blockchains along with state-of-the-art cryptographic techniques like multi-party computing and zero-knowledge proof. It analyzes the adoption barriers of blockchain, such as scalability, regulatory compliance, and compatibility with existing systems, critically and provides solutions and recommendations for further research. This paper presents findings from a number of studies and theoretical analyses to show that blockchain can encourage social inclusion, a circular economy, and cultural inquiry by offering a comprehensive outline of the possibilities and constraints.

articleTitle: Research on Book Information Accurate Retrieval Recommendation System Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, we design and implement an innovative system that integrates the deep semantic understanding capabilities of BERT models, the powerful sequence modeling properties of Transformer networks, and the efficient decision-making strategies of deep Q-networks (DQN). The introduction of BERT greatly improves the understanding accuracy of user query intention, so that the system can match user needs and book content more accurately. The use of Transformer enables the system to update user profiles in real time, adapt to their changing preferences, and enhance the effect of personalized recommendation. The combination of the three improves the accuracy of recommendation, enhances the scalability and robustness of the system, and provides users with a more rich, diverse and personal preference book recommendation experience.
